Three persons, including one Iraqi man, were beaten and kicked by border police. One victim had their face stepped on by a border official wearing boots.

Twelve Afghan nationals, including seven unaccompanied children, were physically assaulted at the border by a group of eight men wearing masks and uniforms. The victims were made to undress, robbed of their money, mobile phones, clothes and other belongings, kicked and beaten with electric batons. The perpetrators set dogs on the victims to chase them over the border to Greece. One victim was bitten by a dog.
Two male Syrian asylum seekers were apprehended by a group of ten border police with a dog. The victims were beaten, threatened with the dog and detained at the police station.

Twelve unaccompanied Afghan children, including a teenage boy, were apprehended and beaten by a group of seven border police at the border. Four of the victims were beaten with an electric baton and three were attacked by police dogs.

The victims were made to lie on the ground where they were kicked and beaten with electric batons and had dogs set on them. They were robbed of their money and their mobile phones were destroyed. The victims were then taken to the police station where they were deprived of food for 24 hours.

Report Export.Description: Four women and a man were attacked when standing in front of a cathedral with banners referring to cross-country women's rights protests. The man was hit in the head, and the banners were grabbed and destroyed.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Armenian demonstrators were attacked by a group of three Turkish men armed with knives and hammers. One of the protesters lost consciousness and was hospitalized after being hit in the head. The incident happened on a highway during a demonstration against the ongoing armed conflict in Nagorno-Karabakh.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Serbia, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Four windows of a Croatian community center were smashed by bricks and the building's facade was vandalized with graffiti.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An area around a building designated to host Afghan asylum seekers was targeted in an arson attack by members of a far-right group and police officers. In the process, tents and personal belongings were set on fire, some items were stolen, and a tire of the van used by the volunteers was damaged. The volunteers were also pushed and grabbed by police officers and hit by another perpetrator. This was one in a series of attacks by the same group targeting the shelter.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A building designated to host Afghan asylum seekers was targeted in an arson attack by a far-right group. Three volunteers were directly attacked, with one of them having gasoline thrown at her, and another victim had a small explosive thrown at her. The perpetrators also destroyed a volunteer's phone with a baton. After the incident, the volunteers were detained by police and expelled from the country. This was the second time over the course of two weeks that the shelter had been attacked by the same far-right group.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A memorial to Jewish Holocaust victims was vandalized when red paint was sprayed over it. The targeted monument is located not far from a well-known Jewish politician's home. The incident happened a week before International Holocaust Remembrance Day.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A statue of a famous Russian writer was vandalized when the hands of the statue were stained with red paint.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male correspondent was attacked and beaten by members of a far-right group during an anti-migrant protest, causing a bloody face. Police officers who were present during the attack did not intervene. The victim is a public figure, and it was the second assault perpetrated on him by the same far-right group.
A man was subjected to homophobic insults and threats and was spat at by a group of eight men at a train station.

Six LGBTI people, including minors, were subjected to homophobic insults and pushed against a wall by a group of four to five boys who aggressively asked about their appearance, sexual orientation and gender identity.
A woman was threatened with being raped by a man on the street when the victim was distributing flyers about voting against discrimination based on sexual orientation.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults, threatened, kicked off a scooter and hit on his chin by a group of people on the street. The victim suffered a wound on the chin and an arm compression.
An apartment window with a rainbow flag was broken when stones were thrown at it by a group of people during the election night. A rainbow flag had previously been stolen from the same window.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: An American gay man was subjected to homophobic insults due to his appearance and mannerisms, refused service, told to leave the country and threatened to be banned from a store for not speaking German by employees in a pharmacy.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults and threats of physical violence on the Internet.
A rainbow flag hung on a private garden fence was vandalized with homophobic inscriptions.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A lesbian transgender woman was spat at by a man in a car while she was riding a bike.
A gay man was threatened because of LGBTI symbols on his clothing by two teenagers on a train.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two lesbian women, one of whom was Indian, had beer spat at them by a person in a passing car. The victims had been spat at before on the streets.
A bisexual woman was subjected to homophobic insults and spat at from behind by a man on the street when she was holding her partner's hand.

A pansexual teenage girl was subjected to homophobic insults, hit on the shoulder, head and legs and kicked between the legs because of her sexual orientation by classmates during a school trip. The victim was injured and suffered bruising.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults, threatened and followed by a group of five people at a train station.

Two gay men were subjected to homophobic insults, threatened by a man and involved in a fight with their attacker in a park. A lesbian woman who witnessed the incident intervened to stop the fight and received slight scratches as a result.

A pansexual man was subjected to homophobic insults and threats, sexually harassed, spat at and physically attacked by a group of people on the street during a demonstration. The victim received a bruise to his left shoulder.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults, threatened and grabbed by his clothes in a supermarket by a man who knew about the victim's sexual orientation.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Windows of the offices of an LGBTI rights organization, a synagogue, and a brothel were broken by the same male perpetrator who later confessed that he acted out of hatred towards gays, Jews, and women accepting money for sex.
A historic Catholic mountain chapel was vandalized, and the next day a cross and a commemorative plaque nearby were vandalized with paint by the same man.

A Bulgarian man received death threats on social media after posting information about a recent anti-Bulgarian incident. The incident took place amidst a surge of anti-Bulgarian discourse in print and social media.
A Catholic church was vandalized when the tabernacle at the altar was destroyed and sacramental wine was spilled on the altar.
Two men visibly identifiable as gay were subjected to homophobic insults and had their feet spat at by a man on the street.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was burgled and vandalized when the tabernacle was opened, consecrated hosts were thrown on the altar and liturgical items were stolen.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, OIDAC, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was broken into and vandalized when the altar stone, a cross and statues were destroyed by a man.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, OIDAC, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized when an entrance door and a pillar were spray-painted with anti-Christian graffiti at night.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: The interior of a roadside Catholic chapel was destroyed when the window was broken and statues of saints inside were severely damaged at night. Destruction of religious symbols had occurred in the vicinity before.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, OIDAC, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized when stained-glass windows were shattered, display cases were destroyed and a church wall was damaged at night. Two cars belonging to priests and parked by the church were also vandalized.

Two priests were threatened to be killed with a knife by a man who demanded money. Panels on the church wall were also torn with a knife. The perpetrator had previously subjected priests and worshipers to anti-Christian insults at Mass.
A Catholic chapel, an image of Pope John Paul II and a statue of the Mother of God were damaged in a fire set by a man.
A Catholic church and a cross at the entrance were vandalized with urine, feces, cigarette butts and alcohol by two men.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A figure of the Mother of Jesus near a Catholic chapel was vandalized with spray paint and an animal horn was left at the site at night.
A roadside cross and a Catholic church door were vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti.
A Catholic church was vandalized when a historic stained-glass window was destroyed by a male burglar.
A cross commemorating a World War II soldier was cut and knocked down.
A Catholic church door was vandalized with spray-painted anti-Christian symbols and graffiti at night.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A statue of Jesus Christ in front of a church was vandalized when a rainbow flag was placed on it at night. Other monuments in the city were similarly vandalized.

A lesbian woman and two transgender men were aggressively questioned about their sexual orientation and gender identity, subjected to homophobic insults, threatened, hit and kicked by a group of people at a train station.
Statues of Christian saints around the city were vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti and rainbow flags were placed at several Catholic chapels.
A monument of Pope John Paul II was vandalized when a rainbow flag was placed on it at night.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender man perceived to be a lesbian woman was subjected to sexual harassment when he was touched on the thigh and subjected to misogynist, homophobic and transphobic insults by a man on the train.
The facade and gate of a historic Catholic church were vandalized with offensive anti-Christian graffiti at night.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults and shoved by a man at a train station at night.
Catholic priests felt threatened when graffiti inciting violence against Catholic clergy appeared on an advertising pole.
A statue of an angel in a historic Catholic church was damaged by a man before Mass. The perpetrator was charged with an anti-religious criminal act.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti and LGBTI symbols.
A gay man was subjected to homophobic insults, chased and threatened with eviction from a rented apartment because of his sexual orientation by his landlady.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic chapel was vandalized with offensive anti-Christian graffiti painted on the outside wall at night.
The wall around a Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti by a man at night.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Disability hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay man with autism was subjected to insults and threats on the Internet because of his sexual orientation and disability.
Catholic priests felt threatened when graffiti inciting violence against Catholic clergy appeared on a cross at a cemetery.
A Catholic church and the information board in front of it were vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti and LGBTI symbols.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: The facade of a Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti and symbols. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Open Dialog Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: The door and facade of a Catholic church was vandalized with hangers and anti-Christian graffiti and stickers. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A statue of Pope John Paul II was vandalized with paint, banners with anti-Christian slogans and hangers. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A church exhibition in a park dedicated to Pope John Paul II was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized with rubbish littered inside.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: People praying in front of a Catholic cathedral were assaulted when bottles, stones, and firecrackers were thrown at them. Several worshippers were injured. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

A Catholic church was vandalized when eggs were thrown at its door. A female perpetrator filmed the act and published it on social media. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Worshipers in a Catholic church were threatened with a knife during service by two women. A man was hit on the head with his mobile phone by one of the perpetrators. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized when figures of saints and pots with flowers were destroyed by a man at night.

A Catholic church was vandalized when anti-Christian symbols were drawn on the entrance, the door was plastered with posters, and money was stolen. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.
A Catholic chapel was vandalized with a painted anti-Christian symbol. This was one in a series of incidents by women's rights activists targeting the Catholic church.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: An exhibition of banners at a Catholic church was destroyed at night.
The Jewish community was subjected to extermination threats shouted by a group of football fans during a match.

An Israeli-owned bar was targeted in an arson attack and destroyed, and star of David graffiti was left on the site. The owner had been threatened by telephone and in person by far-right group members for many years.
A man and his children were subjected to anti-Semitic threats via social media messages by a former male employee.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two persons were attacked by a group of six teenagers with knives and baseball bats, shouting homo- and transphobic insults at a location where trans sex workers gather. The victims managed to escape uninjured.
A man publicly known to be Jewish was threatened with a Palestinian terrorist suicide attack at the victim's office via an anonymous phone call.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A trans woman was insulted with transphobic slurs and threatened with violence at a public place where trans sex workers gather.
A member of Parliament was subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threatened with physical violence via private message on social media.
A woman was subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threatened by her ex-husband via an audio message after she posted photos of her trip to Israel on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two lesbian women, one of Jewish descent, were threatened when a letter containing anti-Semitic threats and powder was delivered to their home. Another woman living nearby had received a similar threatening anti-Semitic letter two days prior.
A man visibly identifiable as Jewish by his clothing was subjected to anti-Semitic death threats by two persons at the airport.
A man was subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threatened with being shot via an anonymous phone call.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A woman and her friends were subjected to transphobic insults at a public place where trans sex workers gather. The victim had her mobile phone damaged.
A woman was subjected to homo- and transphobic insults and threatened at night by a group on the street.

A trans woman and several of her friends were subjected to transphobic comments and physical violence by the police officers who came to arrest them for breaking the night curfew rules. The victim cut her veins but was handcuffed and arrested nevertheless.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: The victims were physically attacked near a place where trans sex workers gather. The victims sustained injuries.
Two victims were physically attacked at a place where trans sex workers gather. One victim received an injury to the jaw; the other on the neck.

A trans man was repeatedly subjected to transphobic insults and physical abuse by his mother for years. In the latest incident, the victim was threatened, beaten, and had his things thrown at him and damaged. The victim sustained bruises and scratches all over his body but did not report the incident for fear of having to reveal his gender identity.

Owners, staff and customers of a Jewish kosher restaurant were threatened when a fake explosive device was deposited at the restaurant door at night. The restaurant had previously been targeted in anti-Semitic acts of vandalism.
A memorial to Jewish victims of the Holocaust was vandalized when flower wreaths placed there a week earlier were destroyed at night.
A house was vandalized when a mezuzah was torn from its doorpost and thrown in the front yard.

A Jewish kosher restaurant was vandalized when its window was smashed and an Israeli flag inside the restaurant was set on fire by a man. The restaurant had been vandalized and damaged a few years before by the same man.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Bosnia-born female politician was threatened due to her ethnicity and accused of having connections with radical Islamists by members of far-right groups. The incident occurred after the politician had been appointed to a governmental position. The victim was subsequently placed under police protection.
A mezuzah on an apartment door was vandalized when it was forcefully sprayed with high-pressure cleaner by cleaning company employees until it fell off the doorpost.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A restaurant belonging to a man with a migrant background was targeted in an arson attack, its windows were smashed, and its walls were vandalized with swastikas. Six people living in the neighboring house had to be evacuated by the fire brigade. Police investigated the incident as a potential hate crime.
A Jewish cemetery was vandalized when tombstones were covered with swastika and anti-Semitic graffiti.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A statue of a prominent Jewish historical figure believed to be of African descent at a Jewish cemetery was vandalized with nationalistic orange paint and anti-Semitic and anti-black graffiti.
A monument to Jewish victims of the Holocaust was vandalized with posters from a far-right group spreading anti-Semitic conspiracies.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: A former synagogue building, now used by a Christian faith community, and a Jewish community center were vandalized with swastika and far-right graffiti during Hanukkah celebrations.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A car was vandalized with swastika, racist and far-right graffiti.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A residential building was vandalized with swastika and anti-Semitic graffiti.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A street pavement was vandalized with swastika and anti-Semitic chalk inscriptions.

A man was abducted, blackmailed, and robbed on a date arranged via social media. The two male perpetrators threatened the victim, saying they would pour indelible paint on him, and that the attack would be recorded, with the video then posted on social media.
A transgender man was threatened with death and the publication of photographs of him on social media because of his gender identity.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male writer was subjected to homophobic insults, pushed, had stones thrown at him, was knocked to the ground, punched, and kicked in the face by a group of six. The victim was treated in hospital for a broken nose and cheekbone. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A gay man was threatened with having his sexual orientation disclosed on social media by a male acquaintance he met on a gay dating site.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A gay couple was attacked by a group of three men at a train station. One of the victims was kicked in the face and knocked to the ground, and his partner was hospitalized after being repeatedly stabbed. The perpetrators filmed the incident.
An LGBTI rights activist was subjected to homophobic insults and death threats on social media.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was subjected to racist insults in connection with COVID-19, and was punched and spat at by a group of girls.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two church volunteers were injured with a knife at an Orthodox church during a Sunday service.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Walls in a city centre were vandalized with anti-Serb graffiti containing death threats and a reference to Nazism.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: ECDD, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Nine people were shot dead, and five others sustained life-threatening injuries at two shisha bars by a member of a far-right group. Some of the victims were of Turkish origin. After the attack, the perpetrator killed his 72-year-old mother and himself at home. The attack was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A male LGBTI rights activist was threatened with rape and subjected to homophobic insults in a message sent to his personal phone number.
A man was threatened with a gun by a group because of his pink hair colour. The victim's male friend was subjected to offensive insults and a milkshake was poured over his head.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man of Turkish origin was killed and four people were hospitalized after shootings committed by a group outside a venue that hosted a Turkish comedy night. The attack occurred after the performance as the audience was leaving the venue.
A gay man was blackmailed and threatened with having his sexual orientation disclosed to his relatives and his wife. The perpetrators extorted money from the victim.
A gay man was abducted, robbed, and threatened with a beating if he refused to be videotaped during a date arranged via social media. He was released after giving money to the two perpetrators.
A gay man was subjected to an attempted abduction during a date arranged via social media.The victim managed to escape from the male perpetrator unharmed.
A train compartment was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti containing accusations about the origin of the COVID-19 pandemic.
A cycling path was vandalized with swastika and far-right graffiti.
Roadside posters promoting the wearing of masks were vandalized with black swastika and graffiti depicting star of David.
A school was vandalized with swastika and anti-Semitic graffiti.
A Tajik gay man felt threatened when his sexual orientation was publicly disclosed on social media by a male perpetrator. The victim required psychological counselling.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 70-year old muezzin was stabbed with a knife at a mosque during prayers. The victim sustained injuries and was hospitalized.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man with an Afghan flag wrapped around his neck was punched by a police officer.

A man was hit in the face and knocked to the ground by a male perpetrator at night because of his appearance. The perpetrator stepped on the victim's neck and stabbed him three times in the neck. The victim’s injuries were almost fatal and he lost feeling in the right side of his face and ear.
Two gay men felt threatened when their sexual orientation was publicly disclosed in a comment on a website.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male Singaporean student was subjected to racist insults in connection with COVID-19 by a group and punched in the face. The victim suffered several fractures to his face and was hospitalized, requiring surgery. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A gay man was blackmailed by a man on social media and threatened with having his sexual orientation disclosed.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The LGBTI community felt threatened when its centre was attacked by a group of five hooded and masked perpetrators who repeatedly kicked the door of the building. This was one in a series of attacks targeting the community centre.

A man was subjected to homophobic insults and threatened with death by two male perpetrators in his apartment building. The victim was punched in the face and had his arm squeezed, resulting in a fracture that required hospital treatment. The victim’s apartment door had previously been vandalized with homophobic graffiti displaying death threats.

Report Export.Source: European Foundation of Human Rights (EFHR), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female Lithuanian language teacher was beaten and kicked by a man when going home from work. On the same day, the victim was subjected to racist insults and threatened with a knife in a classroom by the same perpetrator. The incident occurred in a town with a predominantly Russian-speaking population and was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian man was subjected to racist and xenophobic insults in connection with COVID-19, and kicked in the back, causing him to fall to the ground. The victim sustained injuries to his hands and knees. This was the second time in a week that the victim was targeted by the same perpetrator. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian man was subjected to racist insults in connection with COVID-19, and spat on in the face. Three days after the incident, the victim was attacked again by the same perpetrator. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian woman was punched on the street, after being subjected to racist and misogynist insults, including some in connection with COVID-19, and hospitalized with a possible dislocated jaw. This was one in a series of attacks targeting Asian people in the area. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A man's apartment door was vandalized with homophobic graffiti containing death threats.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender Kyrgyz woman was forced into a car by police officers and taken to a police station. The victim was blackmailed, forbidden from using her phone, and robbed. The perpetrators threatened her with deportation and a re-entry ban to the country if she refused to give them money.
A man was blackmailed on social media because of his perceived relations with the LGBTI community.
A man was subjected to physical violence by police officers during his arrest because of his perceived sexual orientation or gender identity.
LGBTI rights activists felt threatened when their personal data and addresses were repeatedly published in homophobic social media groups, accompanied by homophobic slurs.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Chinese children were subjected to racist insults in connection with COVID-19, and pushed by other children at a preschool.
A man was subjected to homophobic comments and threatened with physical violence on social media over the course of a year because of his association with the LGBTI community.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was sprayed with a disinfectant in front of her apartment door by a neighbor, after being subjected to racist insults and death threats. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian appearance in the city in connection with COVID-19. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two Chinese women were subjected to racist insults and spat at by a man. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian appearance in the city in connection with COVID-19.
A gay couple was beaten near the building of a foreign embassy, where a rainbow flag was being flown, by a member of a homophobic group.
A man with a rainbow tote was subjected to repeated homophobic insults on the subway, and hit on the leg by a man.
A transgender Uyghur woman was beaten by a male perpetrator because of her sexual orientation.
A woman was subjected to anti-Semitic death threats by a neighbour.
Two men were threatened while walking when a man asked about their sexual orientation and also attempted to hit one of the victims.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Three members of an Asian-American family including two children, and a person trying to protect them, were stabbed at a wholesale store by an employee. The perpetrator confessed that he targeted the victims due to their ethnicity and perceived connection with COVID-19. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian woman was doused with an unidentified substance by a man outside her apartment. The victim was hospitalized after sustaining chemical burns on her face, neck, shoulder, and back. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in connection with COVID-19.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was subjected to racist insults in connection with  COVID-19, and was struck in the head by an umbrella by a group of four teenagers on a bus. The woman required medical assistance to treat a cut on her head. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Cars belonging to two Nepalese families were set on fire at night in the same neighbourhood. This was one in a series of similar incidents in the area targeting Asians in connection with COVID-19.

A transgender man was forcibly kept at home, prevented from leaving, and subjected to repeated physical violence by his parents. The perpetrators threatened to kill the victim's partner, to take him to a psychiatric hospital, and to subject him to electric shocks.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Thai man was mugged and punched in the face, after being subjected to racist insults in connection with COVID-19. As a result of the attack, the victim's nose was broken. The perpetrators filmed the incident.
A teenage boy was pushed and grabbed by a group of teenagers because of his gender identity.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian-American teenage boy was bullied and physically assaulted at school because of his ethnicity. The victim was taken to the emergency room as a result. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in connection with COVID-19.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A man and a woman were subjected to racist and anti-Semitic insults, the woman was spat on and the victims' dog was kicked by a neighbour in a parking lot.

LGBTI rights activists forming a picket line were physically abused, detained, and subjected to homophobic insults by police officers. Some of the victims were kicked and hit in the neck. A transgender woman was hit in the nose during her arrest.
Two women were subjected to homophobic insults and were attacked at night by a man who assumed they were a lesbian couple. The perpetrator pepper-sprayed their faces.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Chinese woman was spat at, after being subjected to racist insults by a man. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in connection with COVID-19.

A married Jewish couple was subjected to anti-Semitic threats by a neighbour. The couple are afraid to visibly identify as Jewish because of increasing anti-Semitic hostility in the neighbourhood over the past few years.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian woman wearing a protective mask was subjected to misogynist and racist insults, in connection with COVID-19, and repeatedly hit by a man at a subway station who used his legs, hands, and an umbrella. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in the city.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian-American man and his 10-year-old son were subjected to racist and xenophobic insults, including in connection with COVID-19, by a man at a bus stop. The parent was hit over the head by the same perpetrator. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in the city.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was subjected to racist and xenophobic insults, including in connection with COVID-19, and death threats on a train. The victim had been the target of anti-Asian verbal abuse on public transport a week before the incident.
A gay man was blackmailed after the perpetrator recorded video footage of him in bed with a naked man. The perpetrator extorted money from the victim.
The LGBTI community felt threatened when a group of twenty far-right activists disrupted the screening of a film in support of an LGBTI rights activist.
An Ingush man was committed by his mother to a hospital for conversion therapy.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A well-known female feminist and LGBTI rights activist was repeatedly threatened and had her personal data published and widely disseminated on social media by a misogynist and homophobic community.
Two gay men were blackmailed on a dating app because of their sexual orientation. The perpetrators extorted money from one of the victims.
A gay man was stalked and threatened when his ex-partner posted intimate photos of the victim on social media.

A lesbian woman was severely beaten at night near a metro station by a male perpetrator because of her sexual orientation. The victim, who required hospitalization, suffered a concussion, a head injury, multiple hematomas, and bruises.
A man was subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threatened by a male acquaintance.
A Jewish boy was subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threatened by two classmates at school.
A Jewish boy was threatened to be shot by another boy in the schoolyard while playing football.
A work locker belonging to a Turkish-Jewish man was vandalized with a swastika inscription.
A Jewish woman was continuously subjected to anti-Semitic insults and received threatening letters from her neighbours, especially on Jewish holidays.
A building was vandalized with an anti-Semitic sticker.
A foreign gay man was assaulted and injured during a date arranged via social media.
A traffic sign was vandalized with a sticker of an anti-Semitic caricature. Identical stickers had been previously posted in public areas.
A bridge was vandalized with an anti-Semitic sticker.
Participants of multiple online lectures and meetings with several Dutch Jewish organizations were subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threats by several online users throughout the year.
Participants of a synagogue's online service were subjected to anti-Semitic insults and death threats by a group of boys via video and audio.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Description: A Dutch Jewish author publicly known for a pro-immigration stance was subjected to racist, anti-Muslim and anti-Semitic insults and death threats via emails received around the date of his literary award nomination.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: A Jewish organization was subjected to anti-Israeli and anti-Semitic insults and calls for Jewish extermination via email. The email also contained anti-Christian and anti-Muslim statements.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: A Jewish organization was subjected to anti-Israel and anti-Semitic threats and calls for extermination via email.
Jewish people were threatened when anti-Semitic chants and calls for extermination were shouted by many fans at a stadium during a football match.
Jewish people were subjected to death threats chanted by a group of football supporters near a station before a match.

A man with an Israeli flag demonstrating in support of Israel was subjected to anti-Semitic threats by a passer-by associated with a concurrent protest against Israel, taking place in the same public area.
A man who is a publicly known right-wing politician received multiple threatening anti-Semitic messages on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: The social media account of a publicly known right-wing politician was hacked and anti-black and anti-Semitic content was shared from the account.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian person was sprayed with a fabric deodorizer on a train. This was one in a series of attacks targeting people of Asian descent in the city in connection with COVID-19. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Asian man was sprayed with a cleaning liquid in a subway. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in the city in connection with COVID-19.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A person of Asian descent was coughed at twice by a group of four men on the street. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent in connection with COVID-19.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A person of Asian descent was subjected to anti-Asian insults and had a drink thrown in their face. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was spat at, after being subjected to racist insults and threats, including in connection with COVID-19. This was one in a series of similar attacks targeting people of Asian descent.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male Jehovah's Witness conscientious objector was detained and physically abused in a military unit. After the victim refused to wear military uniform, he was knocked to the ground and beaten in the kidneys, his arms were twisted behind his back, his head was pressed with an army boot to the floor, his neck was clamped by a perpetrator’s knees, and his trousers were taken off in an attempt made to put the military uniform on him. The victim passed out during the attack and sustained injuries as well. This was one in a series of similar incidents of a Jehovah's Witness conscientious objector being detained and abused.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Monuments, buildings, and pavement in a town were vandalized with anti-Serbian graffiti containing threats and nationalist symbols.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Iranian and Afghan male asylum seekers were shot at and injured when leaving a refugee camp that was under strict lockdown restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The victims were hospitalized.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A group of Roma men were rounded up and forced to lie face down on the ground by a group of police officers. One of the men was repeatedly beaten and subjected to anti-Roma insults.

Report Export.Source: Kazakhstan International Bureau for Human Rights (KIBHR), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Kazakh man was killed with a knife at his home in retaliation for an inter-ethnic clash between Kazakhs and Chechens that had happened earlier. Before the attack, the victim had been repeatedly threatened with death, shot at with a firearm, and had his car and house targeted in arson attacks.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Armenian school was vandalized with anti-Armenian inscriptions by a group of four. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Six Syrian refugees were subjected to anti-Syrian insults and shot at by a man when waiting at a bus stop. One of the victims died.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman was subjected to insults and spat at by a man on the street. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A mural depicting a black civil rights activist alongside a reference to an anti-racist social movement was vandalized.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, UNHCR
Report Export.Description: A black man was deliberately hit  by a car and subjected to racist insults by a group of men. The victim was hospitalized with a broken leg, nose, and cheekbone, and required reconstructive surgery and six months of rehabilitation. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two police officers were subjected to racist insults and one of them was kicked by a woman.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A statue of a black Jamaican poet was damaged when a corrosive substance was poured over it. The incident occurred during a period in which anti-racist protests were going on.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A tombstone of a historic grave of an enslaved African man was smashed. The incident occurred during a period in which anti-racist protests were going on.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Honduran man was subjected to racist and xenophobic insults and injured during a fight with a white man. The victim sustained a nose fracture and soft tissue contusion. The perpetrator's female partner, who tried to break up the fight, was also injured. The incident was initially investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Signs promoting the equality of Black and indigenous people, displayed on store fronts and lawns, were stolen and set alight. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A migrant man who crossed the English Channel in a rubber dinghy was attacked on the beach right after reaching the shore. The victim sustained injuries. The incident occurred following political statements that had called for stopping the arrival of asylum seekers via the Channel.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A house of a Senegalese family was set alight by a group of three hooded and masked perpetrators. Two children and three adults died as a result of the arson attack, while the three others survived after jumping from the second floor. The fire damaged two neighbouring houses. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A teenage Egyptian-American boy was beaten with a baseball bat by a man after being subjected to racist and xenophobic insults and threats. The victim was hospitalized with a head injury and a broken hand. Before the incident, the victim had been subjected to anti-Arab insults by the same perpetrator.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black man was hospitalized and paralyzed from the waist down after police officers shot him several times in the back. The man was trying to open the door of his parked vehicle with three children inside it immediately before the shootings.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Muslim politician of Pakistani heritage, his wife, and two children were subjected to death threats by far-right groups. The politician received multiple emails containing racist, xenophobic, and anti-Muslim insults and death threats after he made a parliamentary speech in support of an anti-racist social movement. The victim subsequently contemplated leaving politics.

Report Export.Source: Croatian civil society coalition, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Sixteen cars with Serbian license plates were vandalized and damaged repeatedly over a ten-year period by the same perpetrator. In addition to the damage, threatening and insulting anti-Serb messages were left on the windows of the cars. The incidents were prosecuted as hate crimes.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man and a woman were physically assaulted by a group due to their perceived religion. Both victims sustained injuries. Meanwhile, a car parked near the site of the attack was damaged by the same perpetrators. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A white man was stabbed by a black man who made a reference to an anti-racist social movement before the attack. The victim sustained serious injuries, including a collapsed lung. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: London Legal Group (LLG), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A teenage Syrian boy was stabbed to death with a knife, and his brother was attacked and subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by a group of twenty.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black family felt threatened when a rock was thrown through the front window of their home, their vehicles were vandalized with racist and xenophobic graffiti containing swastikas, and the tires of their vehicles were slashed by a hooded person. A window of the victim's house displayed a sign in support of an anti-racist social movement. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Windows of a recently opened Bangladeshi mosque were smashed with a hammer.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A hostel for asylum seekers was vandalized with racist and xenophobic graffiti containing a swastika. This was one in a series of similar incidents of racist vandalism in the city.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A wall was vandalized with racist graffiti. This was one in a series of incidents of racist vandalism in the city.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black woman was shot and killed by police officers at her home during a botched raid on her apartment.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black man riding a bicycle was shot dead by police officers who were trying to apprehend the man for a vehicle code violation. The body of the victim was left lying on the street handcuffed for hours after the killing.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Hispanic man was shot dead by police officers when guarding an auto repair shop.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A family received a letter containing anti-Asian and xenophobic insults and death threats.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman and her transgender uncle were subjected to transphobic insults and had beer bottles thrown at them by a woman driving a truck. One of the victims was intentionally hit by the truck with its tires running over her arm. The victim was hospitalized with a broken wrist, a sliced artery in her hand, and an injured knee that required surgery.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A gay couple was subjected to homophobic insults and physically assaulted with a belt, rocks, and a recycling bin by a group of two men and two women. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A porch of a white family's house was vandalized with racist graffiti. The family lives in a multi-ethnic neighbourhood. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Three black men were attacked and subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by a white woman on a beach. When one of the men tried to film the attack, the perpetrator knocked the phone from his hand and hit him in the arm twice. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.
The Jewish community was threatened after a man disseminated videos containing calls for anti-Semitic violence on the Internet. The authorities investigated the incident as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black man felt threatened due to a series of racist acts by his white neighbour, including burning a cross near the victim's fence, displaying a swastika and a machete alongside racist insults in front of the victim's house, playing racist music, and throwing eggs at the victim's property. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Hispanic man was subjected to homophobic insults, physically assaulted, and injured by a man.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A commercial building owned by an Asian man was vandalized with anti-Asian graffiti, in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A white woman felt threatened when she was confronted by a black man with a baseball bat following a road rage incident. The woman was subjected to racist insults and her vehicle was damaged by the perpetrator.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A gay Hispanic man was subjected to homophobic insults and physically assaulted by a group of men.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A car belonging to an organizer of an anti-racist protest was set on fire after being vandalized with racist slurs and death threats. The incident occurred one day after the protest and was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man was subjected to racist insults, punched, and stabbed at a gas station by a man and a woman. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Three transgender women were physically assaulted and robbed by three men on the street at night. The victims were subjected to transphobic insults and subjected to death threats by one of the perpetrators armed with a metal bar. One of the victims was grabbed by the hand, and the other victim was hit with a bottle, knocking her to the ground. One of the perpetrators filmed the attack and published the video on social media. Police officers who drove by the scene did not intervene. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A sign in support of an anti-racist movement was vandalized with racist insults, swastikas, and sexual images. Before the incident, the signs installed in support of the movement had been vandalized in the same place on several occasions. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Kurdish construction workers were attacked by an armed group. One of the victims died as a result of the attack. This was one in a series of incidents targeting Kurdish workers over the course of a short period of time.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Sixteen Kurdish seasonal workers were attacked and subjected to death threats, after being submitted to racist and xenophobic insults by a group. Some of the victims were beaten and slapped. This was one in a series of incidents targeting Kurdish workers over the course of a short period of time.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A teenage Kurdish girl was kidnapped, threatened, and repeatedly raped by a Turkish male soldier over the course of 20 days, leading the victim to commit suicide. The incident occurred in a city with a majority Kurdish population.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black family felt threatened when they discovered a red rope with a noose hanging from a tree outside their home. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black man died after being shot three times by three white men who were pursuing the victim in their vehicles. The incident occurred in a predominantly white neighbourhood and was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A cabin belonging to a Native American chief that served as a cultural meeting place was set alight and burned to the ground. The incident occurred two days after photographs of the cabin were printed on the front page of a local newspaper. Homesites of Native Americans from the area had been attacked on several occasions previously.

Report Export.Source: European Roma Rights Center (ERRC), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, OSCE Special Monitoring Mission to Ukraine
Report Export.Description: The Roma community felt threatened when 500 people gathered on a main square, and the leader of the gathering called for the eviction of Roma people. Houses in which Roma families were living were then stormed by a crowd of 200 people. Some houses had their windows smashed, and one had stones and eggs thrown at it, all while children were playing in its yard. The incident has been investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Roma hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Photos from an exhibition dedicated to LGBTI and Roma communities were ripped off.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The Jewish community felt threatened when a social media account was set up to create a list of names of Jewish school students. The same social media account contained posts with anti-Semitic insults and a photo with a Nazi symbol. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OIDAC, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Jewish community leader was attacked by a Syrian man armed with a baseball bat. The victim managed to get into his car, but the offender then hit the vehicle with the bat. The attack occurred after the victim had seen the perpetrator throwing stones into the courtyard of a synagogue. The same synagogue was targeted in an anti-Semitic attack a few days before the incident.

Report Export.Source: Kantor Center, OIDAC, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A synagogue was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti. The same synagogue and its president were targeted in an anti-Semitic attack later that week by the same perpetrator.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Jewish student centre at a university campus was set alight at night.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A synagogue belonging to the Hasidic community was vandalized when eggs were thrown at it.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, Russian Jewish Congress, SOVA Center
Report Export.Description: Thirty gravestones at a Jewish cemetery were damaged overnight.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A caretaker of a mosque died after being stabbed in the neck when he was leaving the mosque. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The Muslim community was threatened by a far-right rally, whose participants incited anti-Muslim hatred and violence, and burned the Koran. Bus shelters, lampposts, and billboards were damaged by rioters, who also set off fireworks, flares, and bangers . A similar anti-Muslim demonstration also involving the burning of the Koran happened a year before this incident.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The windows of a mosque were broken. This was the sixth attack on the mosque within the space of three months. The previous incidents included break-in attempts, windows being broken, and racist graffiti being painted on walls and windows.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Muslim community building was vandalized when stones were thrown at it, and a message threatening its extermination was left at the scene. Two days before the incident, two Muslim men had been attacked, and several buildings belonging to Muslims were damaged.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Bosniak former politician and his father were subjected to threats and attacked by three men. One of the victims sustained injuries. This was the fourth attack on the same politician. The incident occurred on the day of the elections, during which racist and xenophobic insults were chanted in Muslim-populated neighbourhoods, and several buildings belonging to Muslims were damaged.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A lesbian woman wearing a t-shirt with an LGBTI-themed message was pushed to the ground, punched, and kicked by two men who also attempted to rob her. The woman sustained an injured back and scratches on her face. The victim had been attacked before due to her sexual orientation. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Around twelve rainbow flags were damaged or stolen from outside homes within the space of two months, with one of the flags being set on fire.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man was thrown to the ground by two street preachers after asking them to stop shouting homophobic chants into a microphone on the street. The victim sustained a broken leg and required surgery. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Protesters who gathered to defend an arrested LGBTI rights activist were brutally subdued by police officers. A social media page of the police then posted a status joking about the incident.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female feminist activist felt threatened when football hooligans attempted to break into her apartment.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Members of the LGBTI community were threatened with war by demonstrators during a march organized by far-right groups.

Report Export.Source: "Never Again" Association, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A gay couple holding hands was subjected to homophobic insults, punched in the face, kicked to the ground, and beaten up at night by three men near the home of one of the victims. One of the victims had his teeth broken.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The LGBTI community felt threatened when a far-right rally was held next to a university, where participants of the rally burned rainbow flags and chanted threats of extermination.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Participants of an LGBTI rights demonstration were attacked, subjected to homophobic insults, and had eggs thrown at them by hundreds of counter-protesters.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman wearing rainbow sneakers was subjected to homophobic insults and threats on a bus by a man who also stamped on her foot.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The LGBTI community felt threatened when targeted by a neighbourhood patrol organized by a far-right group.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman carrying two rainbow flags in her backpack was subjected to anti-LGBTI insults and death threats on a bus.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was subjected to transphobic insults, threatened, and beaten by a group who broke into her home. The woman was hit in the face with a wooden planter and had her hair pulled out. The victim was hospitalized with a broken nose, facial swelling, and cuts to her mouth and lips.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman and her two queer friends were subjected to transphobic insults, punched, and kicked by a group of teenagers. A bystander, who was also a member of the LGBTI community, intervened to protect the victims and was dragged by the hair, thrown to the ground, and repeatedly kicked in the head. The attack occurred after a Pride march.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two victims were attacked and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of four children. One of the victims had a full plastic bottle thrown at him.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, SOVA Center
Report Export.Description: A transgender man was subjected to death threats, grabbed by the neck, and beaten on the head by a man near a supermarket. The victim was hospitalized with a ruptured eardrum and concussion. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: People with disabilities were spat at and sustained other abuse while out in public, in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two Brazilian women were physically assaulted by police officers during the street carnival festivities close to a nightclub frequented by the Cape Verdean community.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black man died after being shot four times by a man on the street. Before the incident, the victim had been subjected to racist and xenophobic insults and death threats by the same perpetrator on multiple occasions.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The front lawn of a house belonging to a man of Chinese origin was vandalized with racist insults connected with the COVID-19 pandemic burned into the ground, and political signs from his front yard were stolen. Before the incidents, the victim's fence and yard had been vandalized on several occasions.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman of Asian descent was pushed into a canal by a group after being subjected to racist insults, including in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two Chinese men were subjected to racist insults and physically assaulted by a group of men. The victims required medical assistance.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An 89-year-old woman of Asian descent was slapped and had her shirt set on fire by two men on the street.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A black female transport worker was spat at by a man.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Roma hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: European Roma Rights Center (ERRC), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, OSCE Special Monitoring Mission to Ukraine
Report Export.Description: A Roma family of four was attacked by two men using tear gas. A Roma man was beaten up during the attack, and his pregnant spouse was subjected to misogynist insults and was also tear-gassed. Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Serbia, OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Residents of a migrant camp were targeted in a ramming attack by a man who entered the camp in his car while repeatedly shouting anti-Muslim and xenophobic insults. The perpetrator broadcast the incident live on social media.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A building of a Somali community centre was set on fire. Its prayer rooms and an office room were burned down.

Report Export.Source: European Roma Rights Center (ERRC), OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A teenage Roma boy was beaten, punched in the head, burned with cigarettes, stuffed in a garbage can, and thrown off a bridge by a group of four men. The victim suffered facial injuries, including swelling in the ear.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights

The victim sustained facial injuries as well as bruises on his body. This was one in a series of attacks targeting people with a tattoo depicting the same Serbian football club, after a video had been posted on social media with a person displaying such insignia urinating on a memorial dedicated to war veterans.
