A transgender man wearing a rainbow-themed cap was subjected to homophobic insults, threatened with violence, kicked in the legs, knocked to the ground and followed by a man.
A transgender woman was subjected to transphobic insults and threatened with being pelted with stones by a group in the street.
A non-binary person was subjected to transphobic insults and threatened with a gun by a man in the street.

The incident occurred during a protest by women's rights activists. One of the victims sustained wrist and head injuries, requiring hospitalization. A teenage gender-fluid girl was severely beaten by a boy due to her gender identity. The victim sustained multiple injuries, including several broken teeth, a fractured nose and facial contusions.
The door of a Catholic church was destroyed.
The facade of a wooden church was vandalized with graffiti, covering the icons.
Several churches and monasteries were vandalized with red graffiti on the same day.
A 300-year-old fresco at a Catholic cathedral was damaged when balloons filled with coloured paint were thrown at it.
The windows of a Catholic organization were broken, while the entrance door was vandalized with swastika graffiti.
A Catholic church was vandalized when a picture was pasted on the side wall. The picture featured a government minister who had previously condemned an attack on a Christian organization.
The facade of a pharmacy opposite a Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti by a group.
A Catholic church was vandalized when its facade and two posters attached to it were defaced with anti-Christian graffiti.
A 12th century window on a ruined church was vandalized with graffiti. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the church.
A Catholic church was vandalized when the fences were knocked down and a sack of cement was thrown at the door.

The wall of a 13th century Catholic church was vandalized with graffiti.

The facade of a Catholic church was vandalized with graffiti, including anarchist symbols. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the church.

A church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti.
The wall of a Catholic chapel and the entrance to the rectory of a Catholic parish were vandalized with anti-Catholic graffiti painted in red.

A teenage girl was subjected to anti-Christian insults and repeatedly threatened, including with sexual assault, after expressing her stance on abortion in a TV program. The victim's teenage sister was also subjected to threats at school.
The facade of an Evangelical church was vandalized with red paint.
A nativity scene in a monastery was vandalized when the figure of Jesus Christ had its head and arm removed.

A Protestant church was targeted in an arson attack when three Molotov cocktails were thrown at it, shattering the windows and damaging the entrance. The same church was targeted in another arson attack four days after the incident.

A Protestant church was targeted in an arson attack when two explosives were thrown at the gate and the building, shattering the windows. The same church had been targeted in an arson attack four days prior.

A church was vandalized when the piano, a cross, and chairs were overturned, furniture was broken, a fire extinguisher was emptied on the instruments and electronics, the mirrors were smashed, and bathroom and kitchen appliances were damaged. The children's playroom in the church was also targeted in an attempted arson attack.
A Protestant church was set on fire with petrol cans. This was one in a series of arson attacks targeting churches in the area.
A Catholic church was vandalized when the altar and other objects were overturned and scattered on the floor, including songbooks and a priest's chair. A chapel inside the church was also vandalized.
A large straw goat, erected in a central square to mark the first Sunday of Christian Advent, was set on fire.
A piece of a relic of a saint was stolen from a Catholic church and the glass protecting the relic was broken.
A church was targeted in an arson attack when several objects on a wooden table were set on fire, causing significant damage.

The victims sustained bruises, abrasions and lacerations on the legs and arms. One victim had an injured jaw and required hospital treatment.

Two Evangelical centres were vandalized with graffiti. The incident occurred prior to the centres' planned participation in a march in support of the Christian Church's stance on abortion. An LGBTI-rights group claimed responsibility for the attack. Another Evangelical centre in a different city was targeted in a similar incident.

An Evangelical centre was vandalized with red paint. The incident occurred prior to the centre's planned participation in a march in support of the Christian Church's stance on abortion. An LGBTI-rights platform claimed responsibility for the attack. Two other Evangelical centres in another city were targeted in similar incidents.
A chapel was vandalized, while a wooden figure, a suspended window pane, and a holy water container were stolen. Another church in the area was targeted three days after the incident.
The door of a Protestant church was set on fire, the organ was damaged, and a lamp was broken. This was the third such incident targeting the church.
A cross was stolen from a Catholic college and thrown in a bush.
An 18th century Armenian church was badly damaged. This was one in a series of incidents targeting Christian sites in the country at the time.
Several people were assaulted by a group while taking photos of a statue of a Polish writer and women's rights defender draped in a rainbow flag.
The crypt door of a historical Anglican church was forced open and damaged.
A teenage boy was threatened by police officers when they visited the victim at home after he photographed a statue of a women's rights defender dressed in a rainbow flag.
An Anglican church was vandalized and ransacked, its windows were smashed, and the property was damaged.
The walls of a Catholic church were vandalized with the acronyms of two radical Protestant paramilitary groups. A statue nearby was also damaged.
The windscreen of a car belonging to a Catholic priest was smashed and the car's wing mirrors were damaged by a group.

An Anglican church was broken into and vandalized when two stained-glass windows were shattered, vases were broken, paperwork was scattered, and multiple items were removed from the building. Three more Anglican churches in the area were targeted in similar incidents on the same night.

An Anglican church was broken into and vandalized when its window was shattered and items inside were damaged. Three more Anglican churches in the area were targeted in similar incidents on the same night.
An Anglican church was broken into and vandalized. Three more Anglican churches in the area were targeted in similar incidents on the same night.
An Anglican church was broken into and vandalized. Three more Anglican churches in the area were targeted in similar incidents on the same night.
Tombstones at a church cemetery were knocked over and broken.

A life-size crucifix was stolen from a consecrated area of an Anglican church at night.
The windows of a Catholic church were smashed by football fans. The perpetrators also vandalized another church with a banner containing anti-Catholic messages during Mass.

A cemetery was repeatedly vandalized and several objects and flowers were stolen from the graves.
Several tombstones and funeral plaques in a cemetery were broken.
Several tombstones in a cemetery were broken and flowers and plants were uprooted and scattered around.

Report Export.Description: A 45-year-old transgender woman was stabbed to death at home, with her throat slit and stab wounds to her face, by a man she lived with. The incident is part of a pattern of violence against transgender women in the same area.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Human Rights Association (IHD), Kaos GL Association
Report Export.Description: A group of transgender women were attacked outside their home at night by a man who kicked one victim and threatened them with a beer bottle, repeatedly returning to the scene. The incident occurred in an area where transgender people are known to live.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Human Rights Association (IHD), Kaos GL Association
Report Export.Description: Seven transgender people were beaten and forcibly detained by police officers in an area where transgender sex workers are known to live. One victim sustained a broken nose.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A group of women and LGBTI students were physically assaulted by private security personnel while protesting at a university and waving rainbow and transgender flags, which were forcibly taken. Women and LGBTI individuals were also subjected to threats during the protest.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A female LGBTI activist was subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour while detained in prison, where she was singled out for a strip search and subjected to transphobic and anti-LGBTI insults by prison staff and other inmates.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two women detained during an LGBTI Pride march were forced to undergo strip searches and were held in a cell without ventilation.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: TGEU - Trans Europe and Central Asia
Report Export.Description: A 25-year-old Black transgender woman was killed and found near a pond close to her home after having been reported missing.
A historic religious sculpture was damaged and stolen from inside a Catholic hermitage.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was broken into at dawn by unknown individuals who severely damaged religious objects, stole several liturgical ornaments and forced open the tabernacle.
A Catholic cemetery was targeted when three individuals tore off and stole metal crucifixes and statues from graves. This was one in a series of incidents targeting cemeteries in the region.

A Catholic religious image displayed on a house facade was torn down by a man who climbed the building at night. The perpetrator had also entered a church on Palm Sunday shouting and making gestures at religious images.
A statue of the Virgin Mary at a Catholic parish was destroyed at the beginning of Holy Week.
A historic wooden bell tower on the grounds of a Catholic parish was destroyed in an arson attack.
A gay couple was threatened with physical violence, spat on, and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of teenagers at a metro station.
Two historic Catholic chapels were vandalized with spray paint, and a statue of a Catholic religious figure inside one of them was destroyed.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A cross-bearer in a Catholic procession was subjected to threatening behaviour when a man lunged at them and knocked aside the processional cross.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender girl and her mother were physically assaulted and subjected to transphobic insults by a group of three boys after a football match. The perpetrators repeatedly pushed the girl, causing her to fall and sustain bruising and abrasions, and threw her mother to the ground. Prior to the incident, the girl had been repeatedly targeted with transphobic insults by one of the perpetrators, who lives across the street from her.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: Two religious images in a Catholic hermitage were vandalized with graffiti, including a pentagram.
A Catholic church was targeted when unknown individuals forced open the tabernacle and stole consecrated hosts, leaving other items untouched.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A stone sculpture of a religious figure was removed from its niche, thrown to the ground and destroyed.
A sacristan and several worshippers were kicked, punched and subjected to threats during a Catholic Mass by a man who was found sleeping on a pew inside the church.
A Ukrainian woman walking her dog was grabbed by the hand, shaken, and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by two women on the street.

Report Export.Source: Holy See, International Institute for Religious Freedom (IIRF), Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A nativity scene on a public street was destroyed and the figure of the infant Jesus was stolen on Christmas Day.

Report Export.Source: International Institute for Religious Freedom (IIRF), Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: Worshippers in a Catholic church were subjected to threatening behaviour when a woman interrupted a service, shouted insults and forcefully pulled the altar cloth and damaged a religious object.

Report Export.Source: International Institute for Religious Freedom (IIRF), Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A nativity scene on a public street was vandalized when religious figures were stolen and part of the display was destroyed one day before Christmas Eve.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender man was threatened with a knife by a group of men on the street who threatened to stab him, and was subjected to insults due to his gender identity. The victim was also subjected to ongoing harassment by the same group.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A nativity scene in a public square was vandalized when religious figures were stolen and graffiti was painted on the structure four days before Christmas Day.
A Russian woman sitting on a park bench and listening to Russian music on headphones was threatened by a man carrying a hunting rifle, who stated that he wanted to kill Russian people.
A Catholic priest was punched in the face while walking with another priest at night by an unknown man. As a result, the victim suffered a cranial haemorrhage and was hospitalized.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Spanish Foundation for Christian Lawyers
Report Export.Description: A historic Catholic church was vandalized when two climate activists spray-painted the facade with red paint.
A Catholic church was targeted when unknown perpetrators forced open the tabernacle and stole consecrated hosts.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Disability hate crime
Report Export.Description: A fourteen-year-old Ukrainian boy with a mental disability was subjected to ongoing harassment by classmates at school due to his disability and nationality, including the disclosure of an intimate video he had sent privately without his consent.
A gay man was threatened with violence and subjected to homophobic insults by a security guard and other individuals at a train station due to his sexual orientation.

A man from Ukraine holding a Ukrainian flag at a counter-demonstration was thrown to the ground and slapped by two participants of an anti-immigration demonstration after being subjected to threatening and anti-Ukrainian insults. One of the perpetrators also attempted to blow their nose on the Ukrainian flag the victim was holding.
A Roma boy was strangled and subjected to racist insults by a man on his way to school.
A Ukrainian man was physically assaulted, threatened with violence, and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a store security guard.
A Roma man was repeatedly slapped and subjected to harassment and anti-Roma insults by a colleague at work.
Three women were punched in the face by a man in a series of incidents targeting women over the same day. Two of the victims sustained injuries.

Several women were physically assaulted by a man in the street on the same day. Two women were punched in the face and one sustained serious injuries to her mouth and teeth. The perpetrator had previously committed violence against women.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour when a fake social media profile was created without her consent by an unknown person. The victim is an administrator of an LGBTI social media group that has been repeatedly targeted with homophobic and transphobic comments.

A memorial to Roma and Sinti children who were killed in a concentration camp was damaged, with visible axe marks indicating an attempt to remove the names of the children from the memorial plaque. The same memorial had been targeted before.
A man and a woman speaking a foreign language were physically assaulted, struck with a bag, filmed, and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a man at a tram stop.

A Roma boy was hit in the head, knocked to the ground, and had his lunch spilled from a container by his classmate in front of a school building. Prior to the incident, the victim had been repeatedly subjected to bullying and racist insults by the perpetrator. The victim sustained a head injury, developed a fear of attending school, and later attempted to harm himself by stepping in front of a car.

A Ukrainian man and a Belarusian man were punched and kicked – and one victim was stabbed – by a man on the street due to their perceived Ukrainian nationality. The perpetrator also threatened the victims with death and followed them to a train station. The attacker also made a Nazi salute and directed xenophobic and anti-Ukrainian insults at the victims. The stabbed victim was hospitalized and required emergency surgery, resulting in the loss of part of his lung. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

A Ukrainian couple with their grandson were physically assaulted by a tram driver, who punched the man in the lower part of the face after subjecting them to xenophobic and anti-Ukrainian insults. After getting off the tram, the victims were further threatened with a switch pole by the perpetrator. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender male high school student was subjected to harassment, including repeated misgendering and transphobic statements by a teacher.
A gay man was repeatedly threatened in messages sent to him on social media due to his sexual orientation.
A gay man was repeatedly harassed by colleagues at work due to his sexual orientation.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb, Zagreb Pride
Report Export.Description: A wall at the entrance to a residential building was spray-painted with anti-LGBTI and anti-Semitic graffiti.
A gay man was threatened with death and subjected to homophobic insults in phone calls and messages by an unknown individual who stated they knew where he lived and worked.
Two gay men were threatened by groups of younger men shortly before an LGBTI Pride march. Threats of attacks targeting LGBTI people were also shared on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 27-year-old transgender Filipino man was verbally and physically assaulted and seriously injured by two Colombian men in an apartment.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb, Zagreb Pride
Report Export.Description: A 22-year-old gay man was physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults in a park at night after being lured through a dating app.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb, Zagreb Pride
Report Export.Description: A 30-year-old Dominican man was physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by two young men due to his sexual orientation. Another man was hit and a woman was pushed when they attempted to intervene.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 20-year-old transgender woman was threatened by her girlfriend with having her gender identity disclosed on social media and within her community, and pressured to detransition.

A young Ukrainian couple were physically assaulted by a group of people outside a bar after being subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults while speaking Ukrainian. The male victim was punched in the face twice, and his partner was slapped while attempting to film the attack, sustaining an injury to her lip. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

A woman using a wheelchair was physically assaulted and subjected to disablist insults by her neighbour, who slammed a door against her and attempted to strangle her, resulting in minor injuries. Prior to the incident, the victim had been subjected to long-term harassment due to her disability, including neighbours occupying a reserved parking space for wheelchair users and disabling her access to the wheelchair ramp.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A young transgender woman returning home from a nightclub was punched in the face by a group of boys she knew, who then chased her to her house while shouting transphobic insults.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay couple from Ukraine were subjected to death threats, Nazi chants, and homophobic and anti-Ukrainian insults by their neighbour. This formed part of a series of harassing attacks over a prolonged period, including the vandalism of the area in front of the victims’ door with animal waste and other materials.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A roadside crucifix was desecrated when the arms of the Christ figure were sawn off, the cross was turned upside down and trash was hung on it. This was the second act of vandalism targeting the same crucifix.

Two Roma children were physically assaulted and subjected to racist insults during a group attack by several classmates lasting approximately two hours. One victim was slapped, pulled by the hair, and spat on, while several dozen others surrounded them and filmed the incident, which was later shared on social media. Prior to the incident, the victims had been subjected to long-term bullying due to their ethnicity.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman organizing a support group and two transgender attendees were subjected to threatening behaviour when a group of four men kicked the cafe windows where they were gathered, shouted homophobic insults, and later blocked their path on their way home.
A car with a Ukrainian license plate belonging to a woman from Ukraine was damaged when an unknown perpetrator set off fireworks on it.
A statue of the Virgin Mary in a forest area was damaged when its head was broken off.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A drag performer was surrounded, spat at and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of unknown individuals at night after a protest. The incident was reported to the police, but no action was taken.
A person with a rainbow-coloured scarf attached to their backpack was kicked in the ankle and subjected to homophobic insults by a man while walking along a recreational path.
The entrance sign of a park named after a lesbian couple was repeatedly damaged by a group of school students.
A rainbow flag displayed on a university building during LGBTI Pride Month was stolen overnight.
A participant of an LGBTI-pride march had an egg thrown at them during the march.

An individual had a flare thrown toward them and was slapped by a member of a group of young men near a bar on the day of an LGBTI-pride parade after the group shouted homophobic death threats and ignited flares.

An LGBTI-friendly bookstore was targeted when three men damaged property and removed a rainbow flag from the premises during the night. The bookstore had previously been targeted in similar incidents.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: A historic Orthodox cemetery was vandalized when approximately 14 gravestones, particularly those bearing Ukrainian and Russian inscriptions, were damaged.
A cinema was targeted during an LGBTI Film Festival when a rainbow flag was torn down and a flagpole was damaged. A similar attempt had been made the previous day.
A statue of a Catholic religious figure in a Catholic sacred site was vandalized with a tattoo-like drawing on its face.
A Catholic church was broken into and desecrated by a man who climbed onto the altar, spat on flowers and damaged a historic wooden cross.
A metal cross was damaged when its upper section was cut off and it was painted pink.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, OIDAC, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A roadside wooden crucifix was desecrated overnight when it was broken and the figure of Christ on it was destroyed. A similar incident had occurred in the same diocese one day earlier.
A Catholic shrine was damaged when a man broke its glass and damaged a ceramic religious figure inside. The perpetrator was charged with insulting an object of religious worship.
A Pakistani man was threatened and hit in the head and mouth with a baseball bat by a group of three men.
A 27-year-old Colombian man was physically assaulted, kicked in the head and left unconscious on the pavement. The victim was hospitalized in the intensive care unit with a head injury.
A male taxi driver was punched twice in the mouth after being subjected to anti-Roma insults by a group of teenage passengers, who also stole his keys. The victim sustained injuries.

A Jewish university professor was pushed against a desk, punched in the face and subjected to insults by members of a pro-Palestinian student collective who interrupted his lecture. The victim was hospitalized with injuries.
Sculptures depicting the Last Supper in a Catholic sanctuary chapel were doused with gasoline and set on fire by two men, causing extensive damage to the building.

Report Export.Source: International Institute for Religious Freedom (IIRF), OIDAC, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: A roadside Catholic chapel was vandalized when a statue of the Virgin Mary was destroyed and the structure was defaced with anti-Christian slogans and swastika graffiti.
A Catholic church was targeted with a Molotov cocktail in an attempted arson attack.

A foreign citizen walking on the street was grabbed from behind, punched, beaten and subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by a group of six men. During the attack, the perpetrators made Nazi salutes and chanted fascist slogans.

A tourist couple visibly identifiable as Orthodox Jews was chased, surrounded, physically assaulted and subjected to insults by a group of around 12 men shouting pro-Palestinian slogans on the street at night. The perpetrators set a dog on the victims, slapped the man in the face, and threw a glass bottle that injured the woman’s ankle.
An 18-year-old Malaysian man volunteering at a Catholic festival was physically assaulted and injured by three men. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.
Three Chinese men were beaten and subjected to racist insults by a group near a supermarket. The victims were hospitalized with minor injuries.

Two Tunisian teenage boys were subjected to racist insults by an Italian teenage boy in a park, after which a physical altercation broke out. Approximately a dozen people joined the attack, directing further racist insults and death threats at the victims. After the victims were hospitalized, the group continued to shout racist insults and threats outside the foster home where they were staying.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 50-year-old Chinese woman was hit on the head with a mobile phone, punched, slapped, pulled by the hair, and subjected to racist and misogynist insults by four teenage girls while working at her pizza bar. The victim was hospitalized with injuries.
A 63-year-old foreign man was seriously injured during a violent attack that lasted several hours inside a building. The victim was found unconscious and taken to the emergency room.

Report Export.Source: "Pro Futuro Theologiae" Foundation, Ordo Iuris Institute
Report Export.Description: The door of an Evangelical Methodist church leading to the private residence of the pastor and his family was damaged when a gate was removed from the fence and used to break it down.
Two female volunteers were punched and pushed while distributing food to people experiencing homelessness by two men who made neo-Nazi salutes and xenophobic comments.
A migrant man was kicked, punched and robbed of his phone and money at a service station by dozens of members of a far-right hate group.

A group of protesters were physically assaulted and subjected to xenophobic insults by members of a far-right group during a demonstration against delays in procedures affecting migrants and refugees.

Two asylum seekers were shot and injured when unknown perpetrators fired shots from a moving car at a refugee reception centre where the victims were staying. The victims suffered minor injuries to the arm and thigh.

Several children attending kindergartens were threatened when their full names were publicly and repeatedly shared on social media and in the Portuguese parliament by members of a far-right party due to their presumed nationalities and ethnicities.
An Algerian male taxi driver was subjected to threatening behaviour and racist and xenophobic insults by passengers during a ride.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Description: Members of the Hindu community were threatened with a bladed weapon and subjected to xenophobic and anti-religious insults by a taxi driver.
Several roadside shrines were vandalized by two men, who painted vulgar inscriptions on a statue of the Virgin Mary, covered another statue in black paint and drew offensive images on a cross.

A 44-year-old Indian man was physically assaulted and robbed of his electric bicycle and smartphone while seeking agricultural work. The victim was found naked and tied up on the side of the road with several abrasions on his body and was taken to the emergency room.
Four roadside Catholic shrines were damaged during Holy Mass, with crosses torn down, statues of saints smashed and windows broken.
A statue of the Virgin Mary was removed from a roadside shrine and smashed the day before Christmas Eve. The same shrine had previously been vandalized.
A 27-year-old Senegalese man was hit with brass knuckles, kicked, slapped, and punched in the head by at least five members of an organized hate group. The victim sustained serious injuries.

A pregnant woman and her husband, both Hasidic Jewish Americans, were physically assaulted and subjected to anti-Semitic insults and threats by three men, who threw water at the couple, spat in the man’s face, and set a large dog on him.

Two 23-year-old Moroccan men were surrounded and physically assaulted by a group of 15 to 20 masked individuals. One victim was found lying on the ground and was taken to the emergency room with a wound to his eyebrow.
A 19-year-old Egyptian man was stabbed and subjected to racist and anti-Black insults by a group.

An 18-year-old Italian citizen of African descent was punched in the face, slapped, kicked, and struck with motorcycle helmets after being subjected to anti-Black insults and threats by a group of ten people. The victim’s 15-year-old brother was also physically assaulted when he tried to help him. Both victims were hospitalized with injuries.

Two Algerian brothers were physically assaulted with belts and bottles after being subjected to racist insults in a parking lot at night. The incident occurred shortly after an anti-migration demonstration organized by football ultras. Both victims were injured, with one suffering serious injuries to the face and body. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

A foreign man working in waste collection was physically assaulted, subjected to racist insults, and had his phone damaged by two company employees while carrying out his duties. The victim was hospitalized with injuries. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.
An elderly Black woman was subjected to harassing behaviour when she was followed, repeatedly struck with a shopping cart and subjected to anti-Black insults by a woman in the street.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two Jewish boys, aged 18 and 15, were robbed and subjected to racist and anti-Semitic insults by a group of three teenagers. The incident took place as the victims were leaving a synagogue. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A 31-year-old Maghrebi man was physically assaulted, sustaining a fractured jaw that required hospitalization and surgery.

A young North African man living in a foster home was beaten by a group of around ten people. The victim sustained injuries requiring hospitalization. Another young man was injured when he tried to help the victim.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Disability hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 15-year-old Tunisian teenage boy with a disability was beaten and subjected to racist insults by a group of teenagers who also filmed the incident.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Disability hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 15-year-old Tunisian teenage boy with a disability and his friend were forced into an alley, beaten and subjected to racist insults by a group of seven young men. The victim had previously been targeted in a similar attack by the same perpetrators.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Disability hate crime
Report Export.Source: Federation of Western Thrace Turks in Europe (ABTTF)
Report Export.Description: A 40-year-old man with a hearing and speech impairment was handcuffed, placed in the boot of a vehicle, taken to a deserted area, beaten and abandoned by an off-duty police officer who mistook him for an undocumented migrant.

A 19-year-old Bangladeshi man was pushed and slapped by a group who also attempted to rob him. The perpetrators were part of a larger group that physically assaulted two Bangladeshi teenage boys on the same day.
Two Bangladeshi teenage boys were surrounded, threatened, kicked and punched by a group of approximately twenty people. The perpetrators also physically assaulted a Bangladeshi man on the same day.
A man of African descent was severely beaten.
A Ukrainian citizen was physically assaulted by two individuals in the street.
An Italian man perceived as Arab was physically assaulted and subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by a security guard at a supermarket after being accused of stealing.

A Pakistani man was punched, kicked, threatened with death, and subjected to anti-Black insults by his neighbour, who was armed with a kitchen knife. When the victim tried to film the incident, the perpetrator damaged his phone.

A 40-year-old Iranian man was physically assaulted by his neighbour, resulting in injuries requiring hospitalization. A newspaper photographer present at the scene was also threatened by the perpetrator. Prior to the incident, the victim’s family had been subjected to repeated anti-Arab death threats and insults by the same perpetrator.
A young man of foreign origin was surrounded, kicked, punched and subjected to racist and anti-Bangladeshi insults by a group of three people outside his workplace.

A 9-year-old boy from Kyrgyzstan was stabbed to death by a 14-year-old teenage boy at a playground due to his ethnicity. The perpetrator's phone contained far-right hate group content. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
Two female employees of a Russian Orthodox church were physically assaulted by a man armed with a stick, who struck them on the head, stole money from a donation box and damaged religious objects.
A Muslim woman was physically assaulted.
A Muslim woman was stabbed in the back.

A Muslim female doctor was subjected to threats after the founder of a hate group published allegations that she had refused to treat a male patient for religious reasons and urged followers to file complaints against her.

One girl was killed and another injured by a teenage boy who attacked them from behind with a hammer and a knife, using pepper spray. The perpetrator stated that his actions were motivated by hostility toward women.
A Roma child was grabbed by the hair and publicly humiliated by a teenage boy who forced the victim to kiss his feet and demanded an apology for being Roma.
A university lecturer and his wife were physically assaulted by a man who targeted the lecturer for being perceived as non-Russian and attacked his wife due to her association with him.
A foreign boy was physically assaulted by a group of young people who filmed the attack and posted the video online, accompanied by insults targeting people from North Africa.
A Tanzanian assistant priest was slapped in the face and subjected to a racist insult by a teenage boy attempting to enter the church. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A foreign citizen was sprayed in the eyes with pepper spray and shot at twice with an air pistol by another man in front of a supermarket.

Several people of perceived non-Slavic appearance, as well as passengers who attempted to intervene to protect them, were physically assaulted by far-right activists during a racially motivated raid on a commuter train.

A 21-year-old Italian man of Ivorian origin was surrounded, kicked, punched, pinned to the ground, and subjected to racist insults by a group of ten individuals. The victim was taken to the emergency room.

A Jewish boy wearing a kippah was kicked, punched, and attacked with a bottle shard by a man on the street. The victim’s mother and a shopkeeper were subjected to further insults when they intervened.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 36-year-old Muslim woman from Tunisia was struck in the face, legs and lap, had her chador ripped off, and was subjected to racist insults by a man. The victim sustained injuries.

A foreign citizen was physically assaulted with sticks, stones, and bottles by approximately twenty members of an organized hate group. The perpetrators broke into an abandoned building where the victim lived, filmed the incident, and published the video on social media. The victim sustained injuries. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A kosher Jewish restaurant was targeted in an attempted arson attack when an unknown perpetrator poured gasoline on the front door at night.

A Chinese teenage boy was beaten and subjected to racist insults by two Moroccan teenage girls, who filmed the incident and published the video on social media. A woman who attempted to defend the victim was threatened with death by the attackers.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: An employee of a mosque was attacked with a knife inside the mosque by a 23-year-old man who was also insulting and threatening others present. The victim sustained a head injury that required stitches.

A Senegalese teenager was threatened by two Moroccan teenage girls who filmed the incident and published the video on social media. Prior to the incident, a Chinese teenage boy was beaten and subjected to racist insults by the same perpetrators.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A sacristan and several parishioners were physically assaulted during Mass in a cathedral by a man who kicked, punched and subjected them to threats after being asked to leave.
An 18-year-old man who was trying to defend his friend was severely beaten and subjected to repeated racist and xenophobic insults by a group of his peers at a party. The victim sustained injuries.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A Jehovah's Witness was punched in the chest and shoulder, threatened with death and insulted by a man while engaging in religious activity on the street.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti and symbols on its entrances.

A 36-year-old woman of Dominican descent was attacked with a shopping cart and subjected to racist insults by an elderly woman in a supermarket due to her skin colour. The victim’s 9-year-old son fled the scene in fear, and the victim later suffered panic attacks.
A man of Tunisian origin was physically assaulted, chased with a crowbar, and subjected to insults by a group of ten football fans. The victim sustained minor injuries.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A public nativity scene was vandalized when several figures were decapitated and graffiti was sprayed on the decorations during the Christmas period.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was targeted when stones were thrown inside, causing minor damage.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A Catholic church was targeted when sacred hosts were stolen.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Disability hate crime
Report Export.Description: A Bangladeshi man with a disability working as a street vendor was kicked, punched, and robbed of his phone by a group of five men. The victim sustained a fractured nose and lost a tooth.

Report Export.Source: Holy See, Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: Two crosses on the path to a Catholic sanctuary were cut down using metal tools.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A mosque was desecrated when pork products were thrown against the entrance door and facade.
A Black woman was beaten and subjected to racist insults by her neighbours.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: Worshippers at a Catholic church were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who entered the church on Palm Sunday and shouted insults. The perpetrator also attempted to damage a religious statue on the same day.
A male Gambian inmate was slapped, kicked, and punched by two Italian men inside a prison.

A Moroccan man was severely beaten, chased with a baseball bat, and subjected to racist insults by three leaders of a neo-fascist party. The incident occurred when the victim was walking past the perpetrators, who were hanging a banner with racist and xenophobic inscriptions. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

A Palestinian actor and director and another member of the Palestinian community were chased and physically assaulted from behind by a man during a demonstration in support of Palestine. Prior to the incident, the perpetrator played the Israeli anthem.

Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in public preaching were subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour by a man who repeatedly destroyed their religious literature, kicked their display cart, and attempted to strike one of them.
A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized when two spotlights attached to its exterior facade were forcibly ripped out.
A Jehovah's Witness teenage girl was threatened with a shooting at an upcoming Jehovah's Witness event by two classmates.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was stabbed in the hand with a sharp metal object and spat in the face by a man while engaged in public preaching.
A group of Jehovah’s Witnesses were threatened with being shot by a man while engaged in religious activity.
The sign displaying the meeting times at a Kingdom Hall was torn down.
A 75-year-old female Jehovah’s Witness was headbutted by a man while engaged in street witnessing due to her religious identity. The victim sustained a concussion.
Two elderly female Jehovah's Witnesses were repeatedly pushed by a woman while preaching door to door, causing one of them to fall.
A Kingdom Hall was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti.

Members of a Jehovah’s Witness congregation were repeatedly targeted when homemade explosive devices were placed outside their Kingdom Hall.
A mailbox outside a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized with offensive graffiti.
A sign displaying congregation meeting times at a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was damaged. This was the second incident targeting the Kingdom Hall within a few months.
A female Jehovah’s Witness was pushed by a man during public preaching who also spat at another victim, shouted insults and damaged their literature cart.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was struck on the back of the head by a man during public witnessing. The perpetrator also attempted to slap another Jehovah’s Witness and subjected them to insults.
Three female Jehovah’s Witnesses were threatened by a man who pointed a pistol at them during public witnessing.
The main entrance of a Kingdom Hall was vandalized with offensive graffiti.

A Kingdom Hall was damaged when two large stones were thrown at its windows.
The glass pane of a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was smashed with an object.

A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized when eggs were thrown at its entrance.
A window at a Jehovah’s Witness place of worship was broken when stones were thrown at it.
A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was repeatedly vandalized, with bottles and other waste thrown onto the property almost daily.
A Kingdom Hall's boundary wall was vandalized with offensive graffiti.
A Kingdom Hall was targeted in an arson attack when a firecracker bomb was thrown at it shortly before the meeting time.
Two male Jehovah’s Witnesses were subjected to threatening behaviour when a man attempted to run them over shortly after they had spoken to his wife while preaching door to door.

Three Jehovah’s Witnesses were physically assaulted by three young men during their religious activity. One victim was struck on the head and required stitches, while another was struck with a metal pipe.
A park bench was vandalized with anti-Muslim graffiti.
Jehovah's Witnesses were pelted with stones by a man near a Kingdom Hall after a meeting, resulting in minor injuries to one victim.
A men's restroom at a shopping centre was vandalized with violent, anti-Muslim graffiti.

Two Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in public preaching were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who grabbed religious publications from their literature stand, attempted to push one victim, and tried to knock a phone from the hands of another victim who was filming the incident.
Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in public preaching were repeatedly harassed by a man who grabbed and damaged religious publications from their literature stand.

A male Jehovah's Witness was struck in the head with a stone.

A Jehovah’s Witness place of worship was vandalized when a brick was thrown at the building, causing damage.

A female Jehovah’s Witness was struck in the leg by a projectile while she was engaged in religious activity.
A Jehovah’s Witness place of worship was targeted in an attempted arson attack when a man brought a lighter and a jar of gasoline to pour inside the building during a religious meeting.
A male Jehovah's Witness was stabbed with a knife and injured by his hostel roommate after the perpetrator learned of his religious affiliation.
A Jehovah’s Witness was grabbed by the tie and pushed by a man who also threatened to kill Jehovah’s Witnesses if they returned while preaching door-to-door.
A municipal housing complex was vandalized with anti-Muslim graffiti.

Jehovah’s Witnesses were pepper sprayed by a man while engaged in religious activity in the street.
Two male Jehovah's Witnesses were beaten by police officers during a raid.

A 59-year-old female Jehovah’s Witness was subjected to degrading treatment by prison officers due to her religious beliefs. She was forced to stand without sitting for 10 hours and for 13 hours the following day, causing severe swelling and bruising to her legs.
A female Jehovah's Witness was pushed to the ground and threatened.

A 17-year-old Egyptian male asylum seeker was deliberately shoved by one of five people who approached him near a bus stop. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the victim by the same perpetrators.

A female tourist had her arm pulled and a cane thrown at her by a man on a crowded train due to her foreign nationality. The incident occurred after the victim did not understand the perpetrator's instructions in German.

A gay man was threatened with genital mutilation in homophobic emails sent to several politicians and counselling centres. The emails contained homophobic insults alongside the victim’s photograph and telephone number, as well as images of mutilated male genitalia.

A girl of Chinese descent was physically assaulted after being repeatedly subjected to racist harassment and insults by a classmate at school due to her Chinese ethnicity. The incidents culminated in an attack that left her hospitalized for three weeks with a broken hip. The school and education authority did not respond to the incidents, and the victim was forced to change schools due to the psychological trauma she sustained.
A public square was vandalized with swastika and neo-Nazi graffiti.

A car belonging to a man of foreign origin was scratched on several occasions by a neighbour known for his neo-Nazi ideology. The perpetrator had previously subjected the man to xenophobic insults. When he tried to report the incidents, the police did not believe him and instead asked him about his country of birth.

A male kebab shop owner was physically assaulted by a man who attacked him with a chair after earlier driving past his shop while repeatedly shouting xenophobic insults. The perpetrator also shouted at a girl in the shop, damaged the victim’s car, and continued to insult and laugh at the victim after the attack. The victim sustained a hand injury.
Slovenian place names on eight bilingual village signs were vandalized. The signs are close to a memorial to the Slovenian victims of Nazism in the area.
A canal was vandalized with racist graffiti by two men, who also subjected a male passer-by to a xenophobic remark when he tried to intervene.

An Iraqi woman who does not speak German was knocked to the ground when shoved from behind by an elderly man at an underground station due to her nationality. The victim was hospitalized with a fractured thigh and dislocated pelvis, and was unable to work for four months due to her injuries. The prosecution closed the case, treating the incident as unintentional.
A social space supporting migrants and refugees was vandalized with a nationalist slogan and a swastika. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the space.
A Muslim woman was physically assaulted by a man who attempted to force a sausage into her mouth to humiliate her Muslim identity.

A 33-year-old Iranian man was punched, choked and shot dead by his 50-year-old neighbour, who subjected him to xenophobic insults after the attack. The perpetrator had previously made xenophobic remarks and targeted the victim’s property, and items bearing Nazi symbols were found in his home.
Public space was vandalized with anti-Muslim graffiti.

A woman wearing a headscarf was shoved by a large man as she left a pharmacy due to her perceived Muslim identity. The victim was still recovering from a caesarean section. When the victim's husband attempted to confront the man, he ignored them and walked on.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Description: Members of a Muslim family running a hospitality business were threatened and subjected to racist insults by a customer.

A man with Austrian citizenship was physically assaulted and subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by prison officers due to his perceived foreign nationality. The incident occurred as the victim was being transported in a prison van and subsequently at the prison.

A man was threatened with being stabbed by a man who claimed to have a knife while another man shouted a xenophobic insult at the victim as he was walking his dog in the park. The police were called but did not take a report of the incident.
A metro carriage seat was vandalized with neo-Nazi graffiti.

Report Export.Source: Center for education and research Nahla, Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina, OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A mosque was vandalized when satanic graffiti measuring approximately two metres in length was spray-painted on its walls. The incident occurred shortly after a fire at another mosque in the same city.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Roma hate crime
Report Export.Description: A couple was repeatedly hit, kicked in the head and body by a group while being subjected to anti-Roma death threats and insults. The incident occurred after one perpetrator overheard the woman speaking Serbian, and proceeded to attack her. When her husband intervened, the perpetrator called on four men who beat both victims to the ground, kicking and punching them in the head, chest and body, resulting in injuries. The police refused to investigate the incident.

A Ukrainian man was beaten after being followed, threatened and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by two Russian-speaking teenagers at a shopping centre. The victim suffered a concussion and numerous bruises and was hospitalized. He pursued the attackers to a nearby underground station, reported the attack to the police and provided a photograph of one of the attackers.

A Black man was physically assaulted by a white couple at a petrol station. The woman called the police, but the surveillance footage showed that the victim had only defended himself when hit and scratched by the perpetrators. The public prosecutor's office dropped the investigation because the offence was considered minor.

A Ukrainian woman was shoved and subjected to threatening behaviour and anti-Ukrainian insults by a male security guard at a night club, after she asked him for help when her bag was stolen. The perpetrator also insulted the victim based on her age. The victim sustained injuries, including bruises to her leg. Other security officers present refused to help and did not call the police.
A Muslim association received an audio recording containing threatening statements and was subjected to further online harassment. This was part of a series of incidents targeting the association.
Muslim worshippers were threatened by email with a deadly sword attack at a mosque and extorted for money.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Description: A Muslim woman with limited German-language skills was subjected to harassing behaviour and racist insults by four female police officers during a routine youth welfare appointment, including being denied access to a restroom and forced to remove her shoes.

A 67-year-old Jewish man wearing a kippah was knocked to the ground and repeatedly punched and kicked from behind while the attacker shouted anti-Semitic death threats and insults at a bus stop. The victim had been returning  home after Shabbat; he was subsequently hospitalized with severe injuries and had to take time off work. The prosecutor opened an investigation into violence and death threats committed on the grounds of religion.

Nine mosques were desecrated when severed pig heads were placed at the entrance by seven perpetrators. The perpetrators were charged with racist discrimination. The same group was also linked to placing a pig head outside a mosque in Germany.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: Approximately ten Republika Srpska flags were removed from streetlight poles and discarded in a nearby dumpster.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A monument dedicated to Serb soldiers and civilians was damaged during the Orthodox Christmas period. This was the fifth in a series of incidents targeting the monument since its erection.

Two young French Jewish boys, including a 7-year-old wearing a kippah, were threatened, harassed and repeatedly subjected to anti-Semitic insults by a man in an airport while they were playing video games. The perpetrator took a game controller from one child and forced him to dance while filming the incident, which he later posted online with a pro-Palestinian hashtag. The prosecutor's office opened an investigation for violence committed on the grounds of race, ethnicity, nationality or religion.

A mosque was targeted in an arson attack by a man who entered the prayer room shortly before dawn prayers and set fire to a copy of the Quran. An investigation into a bias-motivated crime was initiated.

A 42-year-old lesbian teacher and principal of a small village primary school was repeatedly subjected to death threats and harassment, including homophobic graffiti, by an unknown person after her marriage to a woman was publicized. The victim died by suicide after calling a suicide prevention line and reporting the ongoing harassment and threats earlier that day.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A male doctor was hit in the face when pelted with a heavy medical device by a female patient shouting racist and homophobic insults after he declined her request to extend her sick leave. The victim was injured and was laid off work for several days.

The seat of a school bus was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti. The graffiti included anti-Semitic insults, a message glorifying concentration camps, and swastikas. It reportedly remained visible for at least two days.

A rabbi, wearing a kippah and visibly identifiable as Jewish, was sitting at a cafe when a Palestinian man threw a chair violently at his face. He was struck in the head, suffered a forehead wound requiring hospitalization. The perpetrator was convicted of violence with an anti-Semitic aggravating circumstance, and sentenced to 30 months' imprisonment with a 10-year expulsion order. This was the rabbi's second assault within a week.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina

Two Ukrainian female shop assistants were subjected to threatening behaviour by a male customer who aggressively shouted xenophobic and anti-Ukrainian insults at the victims at their workplace. The perpetrator was charged with targeting the women based on their nationality and ethnicity.

A young Tunisian man was hit in the head when pelted with a pack of water bottles and subjected to racist threats and insults by two men outside a restaurant. The incident occurred on the same day as anti-migrant rallies were organized by a far-right party.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A Croat man was beaten with baseball bats, handcuffed and locked inside his apartment by four men affiliated with a predominantly Bosniak football group following a football match due to the victim's ethnicity. The perpetrators searched the apartment and stole items linked to the victim's support for a rival football group. The victim sustained severe head injuries and required intensive care.

A Ukrainian woman was hit in the chest by a man on a tram who had behaved aggressively towards the victim after hearing her speak Ukrainian over the phone at the tram stop. This incident occurred on the same day as an anti-migrant demonstration organized by a far-right party.
Several foreign citizens were threatened with a firearm by a man who also behaved aggressively and shouted xenophobic slogans.

A Belarusian man was beaten, headbutted and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by another passenger on a tram who overheard him speaking an East Slavic language. The victim suffered facial injuries and a broken nose.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A wall in a school sports hall changing room was vandalized with Croat nationalist symbols and anti-Bosniak graffiti.
A Ukrainian male taxi driver was threatened with death and violence and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a passenger. The perpetrator was later identified as an off-duty police officer.

A man from Zimbabwe was stabbed in the chest after he and another Zimbabwean man were followed and physically assaulted in the street by two male football supporters due to their nationality. Prior to the incident, the victims had been forced to leave a bar by a group of customers. The stabbed victim was hospitalized.

Two Italian student-volunteers were brutally attacked by at least three men due to their foreign nationality. The victims suffering serious injuries, including facial fractures, and one of the victims was at risk of losing an eye. One of the perpetrators had attacked Zimbabwean nationals earlier on the same day. The perpetrators were charged with violence motivated by hatred based on race and nationality.

A 33-year-old gay man was threatened by his deceased partner’s family and forcibly evicted from the home where the couple had lived after the family learned of their civil union. The perpetrators also prevented the victim from recovering his personal belongings.

The Bangladeshi owner of a kebab shop and two employees were targeted in an air-gun attack by an unknown perpetrator. The kebab shop building was also vandalized with racist and white supremacist stickers.
Two women were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who behaved aggressively while shouting xenophobic, anti-Ukrainian insults at the victims after hearing them speaking Ukrainian on a tram.

A 32-year-old gay man was harassed when a stalker repeatedly sent his partner anonymous messages on social media, including through a dating app used by gay men, containing allegations about his sexual conduct and homophobic insults.

Report Export.Description: A Turkish teacher had her hijab pulled off her head, while other Turkish teachers and students participating in an exchange programme were subjected to insults and aggression from local residents.

Ukrainian children participating in a folk festival were harassed when repeatedly subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by two men.

A male doctor was strangled, punched in the head, knocked over and subjected to insults due to his nationality by a man in the clinic where he works. The perpetrator was charged with assault and nationality-based hate speech.
Ukrainian children were harassed by a woman who repeatedly targeted them with anti-Ukrainian insults and remarks while they were playing in a playground.

Two young Ukrainian men and one Ukrainian woman were beaten and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by three men outside a shop. The female victim was also threatened when the perpetrators noticed her filming the attack. One victim lost a tooth as a result.
An 11-year-old Polish-Nigerian boy was kicked twice in the leg and subjected to racist slurs by an adult man.
A young schoolgirl from Ukraine was harassed when repeatedly subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a classmate during a lesson and in the presence of a teacher.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was beaten, headbutted and subjected to homophobic and transphobic insults by a male passenger on a bus after she intervened in support of an elderly Ukrainian-speaking women, who had been subjected to anti-Ukrainian and xenophobic insults by the same perpetrator. The transgender victim sustained facial injuries. The perpetrator was charged with a hate crime.

A 17-year-old Ukrainian girl working in a shop was punched, kicked, slapped, pushed and had her hair pulled by two male customers, who also subjected her to death threats and anti-Ukrainian insults. A male shop assistant was also physically assaulted when he attempted to intervene. The Ukrainian victim was hospitalized.
A 12-year-old dark-skinned boy was spat on and subjected to racist insults by another passenger on a bus due to his skin colour.

A Ukrainian family was threatened when a threatening note containing anti-Ukrainian insults and demanding that they leave the country was left in their baby's buggy. The victims had previously been targeted due to their nationality by their Polish neighbours.
A schoolboy was physically assaulted by an unknown man who hit him in the face when he overheard the boy talking on the phone in Ukrainian.

Four Ukrainian teenage boys were repeatedly punched, spat on and subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a group of Polish students, including adults, near the school where they studied. One male victim was held down by a perpetrator and repeatedly punched in the face by another, sustaining a broken nose and extensive bleeding. Other victims sustained a broken collarbone and a concussion. The victims had previously been harassed and repeatedly targeted with anti-Ukrainian remarks by students and a teacher at the school.

A Ukrainian man and woman were physically assaulted by two Polish men on a bus after they were overheard speaking Ukrainian. They pushed the Ukrainian man to the floor and began kicking him; the female victim was also injured when she tried to help her partner. Polish passengers who tried to intervene were also threatened with violence.
