Report Export.Description: A wall along a roadway was defaced with violent, anti-Bosniak graffiti.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 17-year-old girl was beaten, locked in her room for three days and subjected to homophobic and misogynist insults by her parents after they discovered that she was in a same-sex relationship. The perpetrators also confiscated the victim’s phone and monitored her messages.

A 17-year-old girl and her girlfriend were threatened with violence by the father of one of the victims. Prior to the incident, the victim had been physically assaulted by her parents due to her sexual orientation.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 24-year-old queer migrant was sexually assaulted by unknown men who attempted to exploit them due to their sexual orientation and gender expression. The victim suffered depression and required psychological support.

Report Export.Source: Gay Center/Gay Helpline, Solidarity with Others
Report Export.Description: A 33-year-old gay man and his partner were punched and kicked outside their home by a group of young men who subjected them to homophobic insults on New Year’s Eve. The perpetrators spotted the victims holding hands. One of the victims sustained a head trauma, a broken nose, and facial swelling.

A 23-year-old gay man and his 50-year-old partner were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by two men at the entrance to a metro station in the early morning hours after celebrating the registration of their civil partnership at an LGBTI venue.

A 20-year-old queer person from South America was repeatedly physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by their uncle after he learned of their sexual orientation. The perpetrator later forced the victim out of the home.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 28-year-old transgender female asylum seeker from Tunisia was confined in a house for several months and repeatedly sexually assaulted, exploited and subjected to degrading living conditions. The victim was unable to access hormone therapy and experienced strong gender dysphoria.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 30-year-old gay man with a migration background was forced into a police station, confined in a dark room and made to sign a false report by police officers after a woman subjected him to a homophobic insult during an argument outside the station. The victim suffered a panic attack and required emergency medical treatment.

A 45-year-old man living in a caravan was repeatedly subjected to death threats and homophobic insults by a group of young men over several months. The perpetrators also damaged the victim’s caravan by throwing a large rock at it.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: Three men, including two British tourists of Arab background, were subjected to threatening behaviour by two local Croat men who mistook them for migrants. The victims were threatened with an axe and subjected to racist insults.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: The facade of a Catholic church was desecrated when it was smeared with faeces.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 57-year-old transgender woman undergoing gender affirmation was repeatedly subjected to domestic violence and threatened by her brother and subjected to transphobic insults by her mother due to her gender identity.
A 24-year-old man was harassed, stalked, and repeatedly subjected to homophobic insults by his neighbors over a one-year period.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A newly installed sign directing visitors to a mosque was vandalized when the mosque’s name was painted over and replaced with a reference to a Catholic cemetery and a cross.

A 60-year-old gay man was repeatedly threatened and subjected to homophobic insults by neighbours over a six-month period after an apartment owner disclosed his relationship. The victim’s home was also vandalized.

A gay man with disabilities was harassed by neighbours who disclosed his sexual orientation without his consent during a condominium meeting and subsequently targeted him on a daily basis for about a year.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 17-year-old gay boy from South America was repeatedly beaten and subjected to homophobic insults by his father because of his sexual orientation and gender expression.

A 24-year-old gay man was repeatedly threatened with having his sexual orientation disclosed and subjected to homophobic insults by anonymous users on social media for over three months. The perpetrators also cloned the victim’s social media profile and shared his private images without his consent.
A 17-year-old queer teenager was slapped after being repeatedly subjected to homophobic insults and bullied by a group of classmates for over three years.

A 40-year-old man was pushed to the ground, repeatedly beaten on the head and legs and hit over the head with a glass bottle by a group of four men who subjected him to homophobic death threats and stole his wallet. The victim sustained injuries.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A Bosniak man was subjected to threats and ethnic insults by unidentified individuals who drove past his family home at night, prompting him to relocate temporarily due to concerns for his and his family’s safety.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 27-year-old transgender woman was subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour by two boys who recognized her from social media, followed her through a shopping centre and later subjected her to transphobic and homophobic insults together with others. Some of the perpetrators continued to harass the victim online after she published a video of the incident on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 39-year-old transgender woman was harassed at work when she was repeatedly subjected to transphobic and sexualized insults and intimidating behaviour by a group after she rejected a man’s sexual advances.
A gay couple were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic comments by two men after the couple hugged and kissed in the dance area of a restaurant. One of the victims sustained injuries.

A 42-year-old male teacher was blackmailed, repeatedly threatened with having his sexual orientation disclosed to his school director and subjected to homophobic insults by his former landlady, who also attempted to extort money from him.

Report Export.Source: Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: A mosque was broken into and a donation box was stolen, resulting in damage to the door of the mosque.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 21-year-old transgender woman was harassed and repeatedly forced to remain seated on a couch for several hours while being subjected to transphobic insults and threats by her mother and her mother’s partner. The perpetrators later forced the victim out of the home after she lost her job due to her gender expression.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Islamic Community of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: An imam was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man in a vehicle outside a mosque due to his Bosniak ethnicity. The perpetrator blocked the victim’s path using his vehicle, honked at him while he was crossing the road, waited for the victim outside the mosque, and then subjected him to anti-Bosniak insults.

Three young men were slapped, punched, kicked and pelted with a stool and motorbike helmet after being subjected to homophobic threats and insults by a group in a fast-food restaurant. The victims sustained injuries. The perpetrators were charged with aggravated bodily harm with a discriminatory intent based on sexual orientation.

Three Black men were physically assaulted and subjected to anti-Black, racist, and xenophobic insults by more than ten people in a city centre at night due to their skin colour. The incident occurred outside the local headquarters of a far-right organization. As the victims passed by, a perpetrator approached, uttered an anti-Black insult, removed his belt and used it to strike one victim on the back. Another victim was grabbed by three assailants and pushed against a wall, while the other perpetrators shouted racist insults. One victim was knocked to the ground and was later hospitalized with serious injuries.

A heterosexual man was physically assaulted, subjected to homophobic insults and spat at by around ten young men late at night due to his clothing and perceived sexual orientation. A friend of the victim who tried to defend him was also attacked.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was surrounded, slapped, and subjected to transphobic insults by around 15 young persons near her house. Some of the perpetrators had previously harassed the same victim a few days earlier.

A 23-year-old man was grabbed by the neck, slapped, restrained, held upside down, subjected to homophobic insults and threatened with further violence by three men, including his former co-workers, in the shopping centre where he used to work. When the victim tried to film the incident, his phone triggered an emergency call, and police arrived shortly afterwards, identified the perpetrators and called an ambulance. The victim sustained multiple bruises and contusions.

A man and a woman were physically assaulted when repeatedly punched and slapped in the face, scratched and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of around ten people while leaving a large LGBTI Pride event. The victims were injured and sought hospital treatment.

A 29-year-old man was repeatedly slapped in the face and subjected to homophobic insults by a group in a night club district in the early hours of the morning. His friends intervened to stop the assault and contacted the police, who arrived within minutes.

An LGBTI-friendly bar was targeted in two attempted arson attacks on two consecutive nights, resulting in serious property damage. A rainbow mural on the venue had been vandalized the previous summer.

A gay couple was physically assaulted, threatened with a knife and subjected to homophobic insults by two young men outside a metro station after celebrating their civil union. After questioning the victims about their sexual orientation, the perpetrators repeatedly punched one victim in the face and then kicked him while he was on the ground. The victims sustained injuries and sought hospital treatment.

A gay couple was harassed and subjected to threatening behaviour by their neighbours over a three-year period due to their sexual orientation. The harassment included repeated homophobic insults and having their fence covered in cloths soaked in bleach and acidic substances to make their outdoor air toxic. The victims subsequently suffered from vomiting, abdominal symptoms and severe psychological distress, including suicidal ideation.

A cohabiting gay couple were threatened with a large kitchen knife and subjected to homophobic insults by their female neighbour due to their sexual orientation. The perpetrator then damaged their front door and shattered their window, forcing the victims to barricade themselves inside their apartment. The perpetrator was charged with a hate crime.

A gay man was punched, headbutted, knocked to the ground and beaten for more than five minutes by a man who, prior to the attack, had deliberately tripped him up and threatened him with violence while shouting homophobic insults at a train station. The victim required hospitalization for multiple injuries, while his glasses were broken and his clothes torn.  Police officers present at the scene did not arrest the perpetrator.
Several women were physically assaulted – with one punched in the face – and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of men after two of the women kissed each other at a public festival.

A man was punched, shoved and beaten by a group of young men shouting homophobic insults in a city at night due to his perceived sexual orientation. The victim was surrounded by the perpetrators while walking home from a party. He sustained cranio-facial trauma and rib contusions.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: The ruins of a Serbian Orthodox church were vandalized with symbols associated with an ultranationalist movement and violent, anti-Serb graffiti. A nearby tractor was also vandalized. The site had previously been targeted with similar graffiti.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Multiple locations across a city, including a protected memorial site commemorating victims of World War II, public buildings and walls, were repeatedly vandalized with anti-Serb graffiti, calls for violence against Serbs and symbols associated with an ultranationalist movement.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 20-year-old Spanish man and two 20-year-old French men were physically assaulted in and outside a nightclub within the same hour by a group of Croatian men, sustaining bodily injuries. Both incidents were investigated as hate crimes.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: At least 17 people, mostly men, were physically assaulted, robbed and humiliated after being tricked into attending in-person meetings at isolated locations by members of a hate group. The victims were targeted through fake social media profiles due to their perceived sexual orientation, and the assaults were filmed and shared online. The incidents were investigated as hate crimes motivated by sexual orientation, and one case was investigated as attempted murder.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Three Nepali male food delivery workers were physically assaulted and subjected to insults on three separate occasions by two perpetrators who attempted to steal their delivery bags. During one of the attacks, the perpetrators threatened the victim with a knife. The incidents were investigated as hate crimes.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 32-year-old male foreign worker was punched in the face and insulted by a man who also damaged his bicycle by repeatedly throwing it to the ground. The victim sustained visible injuries. The perpetrator was charged under anti-discrimination legislation.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 21-year-old male migrant food delivery driver was repeatedly punched in the head and subjected to insults by a man, sustaining visible injuries. The perpetrator was charged under anti-discrimination legislation.

A 34-year-old male journalist was repeatedly subjected to threats of violence, homophobic insults and defamatory statements by a colleague and supervisor over a period of more than two years, including in private messages and public comments on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 25-year-old transgender man was physically assaulted by his father when he returned to collect his belongings after being forced out of the family home. The victim sustained injuries and required emergency medical treatment.
A 19-year-old gay man was harassed and forced out of his home by his mother and her partner, who subjected him to homophobic insults due to his sexual orientation.

A 28-year-old man was blackmailed and repeatedly threatened with having his intimate photographs shared with his social media contacts by another man whom he had met through a dating app used by gay men.

A 19-year-old migrant woman was beaten, threatened with being set on fire and forced out of her home by her parents after they learned about her relationship with another woman. The victim was forced to live on the street for 15 days.

A 22-year-old gay man from South America was repeatedly beaten by his brother over a period of more than four years due to his sexual orientation. The victim was rejected by other family members and frequently had no safe place to stay.

A 28-year-old gay man was repeatedly physically and sexually assaulted, stalked, harassed, psychologically abused and blackmailed for over two years by a man who threatened to disclose his sexual orientation to his family, friends and colleagues. The perpetrator also targeted the victim’s motorcycle and car.
A 25-year-old man and his partner were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of three men while holding hands on the street. The victims sustained minor injuries.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 16-year-old transgender boy had his shirt ripped off by two male classmates who subjected him to transphobic insults and questioned his gender identity.  Prior to the incident, the victim had been harassed by his parents after disclosing his gender identity.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 16-year-old transgender teenage boy was harassed by his parents, who monitored his phone, repeatedly intruded on his privacy and subjected him to transphobic comments for two years after he disclosed his gender identity.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 48-year-old Serbian man, a 65-year-old Serbian woman and a 66-year-old Serbian man travelling by bus from Serbia were physically assaulted and subjected to anti-Serb insults by two Croatian youths. The 48-year-old man was punched in the head and pushed to the ground, sustaining a head injury. The perpetrators were charged under anti-discrimination legislation.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: The entrance to a secondary school was vandalized with anti-Muslim graffiti. The incident occurred during student protests against the school's ban on wearing the hijab.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A group of men perceived to be Serb were subjected to threatening behaviour and anti-Serb insults by two men while swimming at a beach. The perpetrators sprayed them and their belongings with a garden hose, swung a metal rod towards them and ordered them to leave.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A tea shop belonging to a Muslim man was vandalized with anti-Arab and anti-Muslim threatening graffiti.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A memorial stone commemorating a Serb victim murdered in a concentration camp during World War II was destroyed after being repeatedly vandalized with black and red paint.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Several Muslim women were subjected to harassment after being filmed without their consent while taking their children to school. The video was published on social media by a local political figure alongside an anti-Muslim message and attracted multiple comments containing anti-Arab insults. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the Muslim community in the region.

A Jehovah’s Witness was punched by a man while engaged in public preaching. The perpetrator also repeatedly knocked over the literature display, subjected the groups of Jehovah's Witnesses to insults and threatened to kill them.
Jehovah's Witnesses engaged in street preaching were threatened with a kitchen knife by a woman.
A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized with offensive graffiti scratched into a metal shutter.

Report Export.Source: Jehovah's Witnesses, Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: A Jehovah’s Witness literature cart was  smashed to the ground by a man who had previously insulted the Jehovah's Witnesses while they were engaged in public preaching.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: The doorbells of a five-unit residential building inhabited by Muslim residents were vandalized with swastika graffiti. This was one of a series of incidents targeting the Muslim community in the area.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Young people of North African and sub-Saharan origin were repeatedly attacked with pepper spray on the street by a man wearing a balaclava due to their skin colour and foreign origin. The attacks were carried out under the racist premise of fighting crime while being filmed and posted to social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC), Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: The facade of a mosque and several businesses in the area were vandalized with graffiti depicting swastikas and containing anti-Arab and xenophobic insults. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime. This was one of three incidents targeting the mosque within a short period of time.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A mosque and a nearby shop were vandalized with anti-Arab graffiti. The incident was one of three attacks targeting the mosque within a short period.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A mosque was desecrated when pieces of pork were placed at its entrance. The incident was one of three attacks targeting the mosque within a short period.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 31-year-old male migrant delivery driver was physically assaulted and robbed. The incident was one of two attacks targeting foreign workers in the city on the same evening.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 35-year-old male migrant delivery driver was physically assaulted with a blunt object and robbed. The victim had his mobile phone and documents stolen and sustained serious injuries, requiring medical treatment. The incident was one of two attacks targeting foreign workers in the city on the same evening.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A university building was vandalized with offensive graffiti and xenophobic posters while the institution was hosting a course on combatting Islamophobia.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Unaccompanied migrant children staying in asylum centres were harassed and subjected to anti-Muslim and racist insults.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A male migrant delivery driver was physically assaulted and had his electric bicycle stolen. This was one in a series of incidents targeting foreign nationals in the city during the month.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 25-year-old Filipino male foreign worker was physically assaulted by two individuals and had his electric scooter stolen. This was one in a series of incidents targeting foreign nationals in the city during the month.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A building used as a mosque was desecrated when pork meat, animal entrails and sausages were placed at its entrance during the night. This was one of a series of anti-Muslim incidents targeting properties in the area.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 38-year-old foreign man was physically assaulted by a group of three men, who forced him to the ground, robbed him of a sum of cash and struck him repeatedly in the head and body. The victim sustained minor injuries. This was one in a series of incidents targeting foreign nationals in the city during the month.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A young man of African descent was physically assaulted by a group of seven police officers after being stopped and ordered to empty his pockets outside a nightclub. The officers restrained him, threw him to the ground and repeatedly struck him, while one officer pressed his knee against the victim's neck. The victim sustained injuries.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Muslim hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Around a dozen feminist murals in several cities were vandalized when the faces of women depicted in the murals were covered with spray-painted headscarves and the murals were defaced with anti-Muslim inscriptions. Members of an organized hate group claimed responsibility for the incidents and encouraged further vandalism.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 37-year old male food delivery driver was physically assaulted by three men who stole his bicycle, delivery bag and other belongings. This was one in a series of incidents targeting foreign workers in the city during the same period.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: The road and entrance sign of a predominantly Serbian village were vandalized with violent, anti-Serb graffiti, including far-right symbols. The incident occurred shortly before a commemoration of local victims of World War II persecution.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Roma hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A memorial sculpture within a memorial park commemorating victims of persecution of Serbs, Jews and Roma during World War II was vandalized with far-right graffiti.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Participants in a Serbian cultural event were subjected to threatening behaviour when approximately 50 masked men forced them to leave the venue while shouting Croatian ultranationalist salutes and slogans, preventing the event from taking place.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: The president of a Serbian minority political party was threatened with death in numerous social media comments that also called for violence against Serbs beneath a video of his parliamentary speech.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: The wall of a school sports hall was vandalized with violent, anti-Serb graffiti and symbols associated with an ultranationalist movement, while a group of approximately fifty men gathered at the site shouting ultranationalist slogans. The incident occurred several days after another anti-Serb incident in the same neighbourhood.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Two male foreign food delivery workers were physically assaulted by the same perpetrator, who stole their electric bicycles and a mobile phone in two attacks minutes apart in the same district. One of the victims was repeatedly punched and kicked. Video footage of one of the assaults was circulated online.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Several private homes belonging to members of the Serbian community in neighbouring villages were vandalized with anti-Serb graffiti in a coordinated attack carried out overnight.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A 22-year-old Indian man origin was physically assaulted by two men who threw firecrackers at him before assaulting him and damaging his helmet. The victim sustained visible injuries.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: A group of Italian men were physically assaulted by approximately 15 masked men at a stadium shortly before a football match between two Croatian clubs, after one of the perpetrators asked where they were from. The victims were repeatedly punched and kicked, including after falling to the ground. Several victims sustained injuries, and one victim suffered a fractured skull.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: Four Bosniak men were physically assaulted by a group of men near a predominantly Bosniak neighbourhood during celebrations marking Republika Srpska Day. A 75-year-old victim sustained the most serious injuries, while the three other victims sustained minor injuries.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A 36-year-old man of Moroccan origin was beaten, pinned down, and strangled to death by two police officers who restrained him by holding his neck with an arm while sitting on his body. This was the third death of a person from an ethnic or racial minority background resulting from police actions in recent months.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: An Orthodox priest was physically assaulted and subjected to insults by a Bosniak man in an area where several Serbian Orthodox religious institutions are located.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A young man of North African origin was chased by a crowd of around 200 people and forced to seek refuge in the city hall, where he was placed under police protection. The crowd subsequently attempted to force its way into the building to confront the victim. The incident followed a bar fight involving the victim and formed part of a series of incidents targeting people of North African origin in the town that night.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A person of North African origin was physically assaulted while returning home during local festival celebrations. This was part of a series of incidents targeting people of North African origin in the town that night.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A person of North African origin was physically assaulted during local festival celebrations. This was part of a series of incidents targeting people of North African origin in the town that night.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 34-year-old transgender woman was subjected to death threats and online harassment by a man for over two years. The perpetrator stalked her on social media, attempted to extort money from her, repeatedly subjected her to transphobic insults and shared private images of her children without her consent.

Two Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in public preaching were subjected to threatening behaviour by two men who repeatedly subjected them to insults, grabbed one victim’s phone and threw it to the ground. The same perpetrators had repeatedly harassed and threatened Jehovah’s Witnesses over several years.

Report Export.Source: Jehovah's Witnesses, Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: Two Jehovah’s Witnesses were chased in the street and threatened with having their throats cut by a man armed with a knife while engaging in street witnessing.
Jehovah’s Witness literature displays were vandalized by a man who threw them to the ground, spat on them and stamped on them until they broke while the victims were engaged in public preaching.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was repeatedly hit on the head by a man while engaged in door-to-door preaching after the perpetrator requested that the Jehovah's Witnesses leave.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: Two Israeli tourists were attacked with a knife on a central street after the perpetrators identified them as Jewish because they were speaking Hebrew and one was wearing a Star of David necklace. One victim sustained a stab wound to the forehead.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A male Israeli tourist was punched and repeatedly kicked in the face by a group of individuals who subjected him to anti-Semitic insults.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A 35-year-old male Israeli tourist was chased, physically assaulted and kicked by a group after an application on his phone was heard speaking Hebrew and he confirmed that he was Israeli. The perpetrators pursued him into a restaurant, attempted to force open the bathroom door where he had taken refuge and discussed using an axe. The attack occurred in the context of a protest related to the conflict in the Middle East. The victim required hospital treatment.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A group of 17-year-old Israeli teenagers was physically assaulted and subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of men who targeted them because of their Israeli nationality. The perpetrators chased the group and kicked one male teenager while filming the assault. The incident occurred in the context of protests related to the conflict in the Middle East.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: Israel’s national football team coach and his assistant were physically assaulted by a man who shoved them and made derogatory remarks and references to the conflict in the Middle East after overhearing them speaking Hebrew.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A male Israeli tourist was physically assaulted on a beach by a man who bit off part of his ear during a confrontation, requiring hospital treatment. Prior to the incident, the perpetrator had filmed the victim and other Israeli tourists, directed anti-Israel remarks at them, including references to the conflict in the Middle East, and thrown sand at them.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: The office of a university professor known for her work combating anti-Semitism was vandalized with anti-Zionist graffiti referencing the conflict in the Middle East, and leaflets were scattered at the site.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A Jewish cemetery was vandalized with anti-Zionist graffiti calling for violence and referencing the conflict in the Middle East.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A memorial commemorating the historic Jewish cemetery on a university campus was desecrated.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A memorial dedicated to Jewish victims of the Holocaust was vandalized with red spray paint.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS, International Institute for Religious Freedom (IIRF)
Report Export.Description: A synagogue was vandalized with anti-Semitic and anti-Zionist graffiti referencing the conflict in the Middle East. The incident occurred one day after a Holocaust memorial in the same city was vandalized.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: The offices of a Jewish community organization were vandalized with red paint during a political demonstration.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: The offices of an Israeli real estate company were broken into and vandalized with red paint.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A municipal sign was vandalized with an anti-Semitic slogan.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A Greek staff member at an Israeli-owned kosher restaurant was threatened by a group of six masked individuals who warned him not to leave the premises. The perpetrators also vandalized the restaurant with anti-Zionist graffiti and references to the conflict in the Middle East and scattered leaflets inside.
A police officer was subjected to threatening behaviour and homophobic insults by a man during an arrest. The perpetrator was charged with a homophobically aggravated public order offence.
A store employee was harassed by a male customer who repeatedly subjected him to racist insults and remarks. The perpetrator was charged and sentenced for a racially aggravated public order offence.

A person was subjected to threatening behaviour and homophobic insults by a male neighbour during a dispute. The perpetrator was prosecuted for a homophobically aggravated public order offence, given a 80-hour community order, and ordered to pay the victim compensation.

Several staff members at a railway station were subjected to threatening behaviour and homophobic insults by a man who had been causing a disturbance. The perpetrator was charged with a homophobically aggravated public order offence and ordered to pay compensation and a fine.

A Muslim man was punched in the chest by a man who had approached the victim and other Muslim worshippers, including children, and shouted anti-Muslim and racist insults at them while they prayed outside a mosque. The perpetrator kicked a prayer mat before leaving, but later returned with a knife which he pulled out before running away as police sirens approached. The perpetrator was charged with a racially and religiously aggravated hate crime.

Nine Asian-owned businesses, mostly Chinese restaurants, nail salons and an Asian market in the same town had their windows smashed by a man over the course of two days. No other businesses were targeted. The perpetrator was sentenced to 12 months' imprisonment and ordered to pay compensation for nine counts of racially and religiously aggravated criminal damage.

Three dark-skinned men were threatened by a group of 40-50 people who surrounded their car and shook it violently, hitting and kicking the body and windows, while shouting racist abuse and threatening the occupants due to their skin colour. A second car was damaged as the crowd dispersed. Police investigated the incident as a racially motivated hate crime and increased their presence in the area.
A man was physically assaulted near a railway station at night due to his ethnicity. Police investigated the incident as a racially aggravated attack.

A Muslim schoolgirl was physically assaulted by a man due to her religion as she walked home alone from school. A similar incident targeting a 15-year-old girl had previously occurred on the same street.

Four synagogues, a Jewish school, and two Jewish-owned properties were desecrated and vandalized when smeared with faeces and urine by a man over a nine-day period. All incidents occurred in the early morning. The incidents were investigated as religiously motivated criminal damage.

A visibly Orthodox Jewish man was subjected to threatening behaviour when locked inside a public bus for one hour by the driver, who had previously subjected the victim to anti-Semitic remarks. The perpetrator had also refused to return the victim’s bank card after he dropped it near the driver's cabin. Police investigated the incident as a potential hate crime.

A man was grabbed by two masked men who also shone a bright light into his eyes while he was walking in a city park in the early hours due to his perceived sexual orientation. Police treated the incident as potentially homophobic and as part of a series of similar attacks on men in the same location over a short period.

A Jewish teenage boy wearing a kippah and his companion were shot at from a car with an air gun by a man shouting anti-Semitic insults as they walked toward a synagogue. The boy was hit in the forehead, causing a minor head wound and swelling. The incident happened in the same weekend as several Jewish homes in the same town were targeted with swastika graffiti.

A rabbi's home was vandalized with swastika graffiti on the eve of Shabbat. The house was identifiable as a Jewish residence by the mezuzah on the doorframe. At least four Jewish properties were daubed with swastika graffiti on the same night as part of a series of anti-Semitic incidents in the town.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A person was pushed and subjected to a transphobic insult by another person at a bus station.

A Jehovah's Witness congregation was threatened in a letter containing threats and hate symbols that was left in a Kingdom Hall. Their place of worship was also vandalized with paint and dog faeces on the same day.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A memorial column commemorating a historic Jewish neighbourhood destroyed in an anti-Semitic pogrom was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti and spray paint.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A Holocaust memorial and a synagogue were vandalized with swastika and other graffiti referencing International Holocaust Remembrance Day.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A Jewish student was threatened when graffiti containing his name next to a reference to the concentration and extermination camp, depicted inside a flame, was painted on a university building.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: Municipal garbage bins in the city centre were vandalized with anti-Semitic, anti-Zionist and anti-Israel graffiti referencing the conflict in the Middle East.

Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: A bar was vandalized with anti-Israel graffiti and posters referencing the conflict in the Middle East after being targeted for hosting groups of Israeli tourists.
A 46-year-old Indian man working as a taxi driver was hit over the head with a glass bottle and subjected to xenophobic insults by two young men at night, causing him to bleed.

A six-year-old girl of Indian descent was punched in the face and had her hair pulled and a bicycle pressed against body while being subjected to racist and xenophobic insults by a group of teenagers aged 11 to 13 while playing near her home. The victim sustained facial swelling and genital pain.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two drag performers were physically assaulted by unknown perpetrators due to their perceived gender identity and gender expression.
Public roads were vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A man of Pakistani origin was stabbed to death by another man while working in a store. This was one is a series of attacks on businesses owned by members of the Pakistani community.

A 28-year-old Peruvian man was repeatedly beaten over the face and head and subjected to xenophobic insults by three men while taking the metro to work. The victim was hospitalized with a deep cut to the back of his head, suffered permanent vision loss and required eye surgery.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A mosque was vandalized with xenophobic graffiti.

Three young migrants, including two children, were beaten by two masked men near a shelter for child migrants. The adult victim required hospitalization. The attack occurred shortly after the arrest of a Moroccan minor suspected of raping a 14-year-old girl in a district park.

Report Export.Source: UNHCR, Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Migrants and women workers accompanying them at a support centre were subjected to threatening behaviour by extremist groups patrolling the area around the centre. The incident occurred amid demonstrations against the centre organized by far-right groups.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: An Israeli soldier was threatened after an anarchist group disclosed his identity and home address and posted a video showing masked individuals breaking into his apartment by smashing its windows with metal bars.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Migrants receiving services at a support centre were threatened when graffiti depicting a swastika and a death threat directed at Black people appeared near the centre. The incident occurred amid demonstrations against the centre and street patrols in the surrounding area organized by far-right groups.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Muslim hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A bridge was vandalized with graffiti containing xenophobic, anti-migrant, anti-Muslim, anti-Latino, anti-Arab, and anti-Black inscriptions.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: People of North African origin were physically assaulted, harassed and subjected to racist and anti-Arab insults by members of several far-right groups patrolling the streets. The attacks also resulted in serious damage to private property. The perpetrators were mobilized by organized hate groups calling for armed attacks and the extermination of Moroccans, Black people, Indians and other migrants.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Semitic hate crime
Report Export.Source: Central Board of Jewish Communities in Greece - KIS
Report Export.Description: Members of three British Jewish families, including minors, were subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour and expelled from a restaurant after questioning posters and stickers referencing the conflict in the Middle East. They were subjected to anti-Semitic, anti-Zionist and anti-Israel insults, while the owner pursued them into the car park and locked the gates and other visitors jeered and applauded their departure.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman was targeted in an attempted abduction by three men, one armed with a firearm and another with a knife, who tried to force her into a vehicle before fleeing when a passerby intervened. Police investigated the incident as part of a series of hate-motivated crimes targeting women and Jewish people.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two women were chased by three armed men in an attempted abduction due to their gender. The perpetrators fled after a bystander intervened. Police investigated the incident as part of a series of hate-motivated crimes targeting women.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 15-year-old Ukrainian girl was repeatedly harassed by approximately 15 classmates at a private school who subjected her to anti-Ukrainian and xenophobic insults and created a private social-media group to humiliate her.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 13-year-old Polish boy was physically assaulted by a group of classmates who placed a plastic bag over his head, cornered him and pushed him into a wall. The victim sustained injuries requiring hospitalization. He had been repeatedly targeted due to his Polish nationality over the previous two years. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 67-year-old female nurse of Indian origin was repeatedly punched in the face by a male patient who made derogatory statements about Indian people during the attack. The victim sustained multiple facial fractures, a brain bleed and possible permanent vision loss. The perpetrator was charged with attempted murder with a hate-crime enhancement.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Exhibition boards presenting the stories of 20 LGBTI people were vandalized with anti-LGBTI graffiti by a far-right political candidate, causing significant financial damage.

Report Export.Description: An Iranian man was followed, physically assaulted, and subjected to anti-Pakistani insults by his Spanish neighbour at a bus stop. This was one in a series of incidents targeting the victim by the same perpetrator.

Report Export.Description: An Iranian man was harassed by his Spanish neighbour who repeatedly slammed doors at night and made noise to disturb him. Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Muslim hate crime, Gender-based hate crime
Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: A Muslim woman and her two minor daughters were subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour by another woman while swimming in covered swimwear at a residential pool. The perpetrator forced one of the daughters out of the pool, subjected the mother to misogynist insults, filmed the incident and shared the video on social media.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Visitors and staff at a mosque were threatened through several phone calls warning of a bomb attack and containing anti-Muslim insults, prompting the deployment of national police units. The incident was prosecuted as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain

Report Export.Source: Union of Islamic Communities of Spain
Report Export.Description: Several Moroccan girls were threatened with death and serious physical violence by two adult female neighbours who also shouted far-right slogans at them. Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 71-year-old Asian American male professor was hit by a vehicle while riding his bicycle by a perpetrator who shouted an anti-Chinese insult before fleeing the scene. The victim sustained serious injuries to his elbow, neck, cheekbones, jaw, hips and lower back. The incident was investigated as potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male and a female Israeli Embassy staff member were shot and killed by a man outside a Jewish museum after attending a Jewish cultural event there. The perpetrator made statements referring to the conflict in the Middle East following his arrest. The incident was investigated as a hate crime and an act of terrorism.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 19-year-old woman was punched and kicked unconscious by two male perpetrators at a fast-food restaurant after being subjected to a homophobic insult and a death threat due to her perceived sexual orientation. The victim sustained a broken nose and temporary vision loss. One perpetrator was subsequently charged with a hate crime.

Report Export.Description: A queer bar was broken into and vandalized during LGBTI Pride weekend, with homophobic graffiti spray-painted on a wall, alcohol stolen, the front door smashed and the building’s electricity shut off.

A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized when stones were thrown at its windows and a red sticky liquid was smeared on the alarm and door lock.

Jehovah's Witnesses were pushed while engaged in door-to-door preaching.

Members of a Jehovah’s Witness congregation were threatened with being shot in a voicemail left at their Kingdom Hall.
Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in door-to-door preaching were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who followed them as they left the area.
A Jehovah’s Witness was threatened with physical violence by a man while preaching door to door.
A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was targeted when its glass door was damaged and two signs were stolen.
A glass window at a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was smashed.
The entrance door and outdoor lighting of a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall were damaged.
The entrance sign of a Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was vandalized with offensive graffiti and stickers.
A Jehovah’s Witness Kingdom Hall was targeted in an arson attack.
One male and two female Jehovah's Witnesses were threatened with having their heads cut off and their cars set on fire by a man.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was forced to undress, repeatedly beaten with fists, including in the stomach, and threatened with criminal prosecution by police officers due to his religious activity.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Jewish-owned business was vandalized after masked perpetrators smashed its windows, sprayed red paint and graffiti referring to the conflict in the Middle East, and damaged computers and furniture inside the premises. The incident was later claimed by an anti-Israel activist group. The incident was investigated as racially aggravated criminal damage.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Staff at a handicraft shop were threatened with physical violence and arson by five teenage boys who repeatedly shouted anti-LGBTI, anti-Semitic and misogynist insults while demanding the removal of rainbow-themed items. After being made to leave, the perpetrators attempted to force their way back into the shop and continued threatening and intimidating the staff.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Serbian female journalist was physically assaulted by a man who grabbed the handlebars of her bicycle while she was riding and subjected her to xenophobic insults, causing her to fall. The victim sustained a broken leg and a fractured hand and required multiple surgeries. The same perpetrator had attacked her several months earlier.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Jewish-owned kosher grocery store was vandalized when two masked perpetrators threw a brick bearing a reference to the conflict in the Middle East through its front window. The incident occurred in a predominantly Jewish neighbourhood and was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man was punched, knocked unconscious and repeatedly kicked by a group of approximately six people who had shouted anti-Semitic insults and references to the conflict in the Middle East and followed him and his Jewish friend after she disclosed her Jewish identity. A bystander who attempted to intervene was also physically assaulted. One perpetrator was charged with a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two female activists distributing stickers supporting LGBTI people at a religious festival were physically assaulted by attendees who threw objects at them, including a board with a protruding nail, sticks and eggs, and were sprayed with water by a group of teenagers for nearly 30 minutes. The victims were also subjected to repeated homophobic insults and a chanted death threat. At the same event, a bottle of urine was thrown into a rest space for LGBTI attendees.

Report Export.Description: A Hindu temple operated by the International Society for Krishna Consciousness was targeted in multiple shooting attacks over several nights, during which 20 to 30 rounds were fired at the building, damaging its exterior, windows, and the main worship hall. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A man was subjected to threats and racist and xenophobic insults by his male neighbour, who banged on the victim’s door during the night before smashing his car windows and headlights with a shovel and damaging the balcony door of his apartment.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 26-year-old Algerian Muslim woman was fatally stabbed by a male neighbour in the stairwell of her apartment building. The victim had previously been subjected to repeated harassment and insults by the same perpetrator due to her Muslim faith and Arab origin.

Report Export.Description: An Indian man was punched in the face and body by a group of teenagers while walking to a Hindu temple. The perpetrators struck him in the head and stripped him of his trousers after questioning why he was in the country. The victim sustained a broken nose and serious facial injuries. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Indian female nurse training for a marathon was physically assaulted by two teenagers on an e-scooter who threw a glass bottle that struck her leg, causing a minor injury. This was one in a series of incidents targeting people of Indian origin in the area.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A mosque was desecrated when meat believed to be pork was placed on its entrance and door handles and an Israeli flag was attached to one of its doors. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Israeli singer and orchestra members were subjected to threatening behaviour by two women who poured red paint over the performers and stage during a concert. One perpetrator also attempted to unfurl a Palestinian flag before being stopped by security. The perpetrators were charged with an offence motivated by xenophobia, racism or religious intolerance.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two Ukrainian men were physically assaulted and threatened after being subjected to anti-Ukrainian insults by a group of men who heard them speaking Ukrainian outside a shop. After the victims asked the perpetrators to stop following them, two of the men attacked them, causing one victim to lose a tooth and require medical treatment.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A woman was hit in the face by a male staff member at a political campaign headquarters who had also subjected her to misogynist and sexualized gestures.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A car belonging to a Ukrainian citizen was vandalized when its licence plates were stolen and its bodywork was spray-painted with an anti-Ukrainian message.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Ukrainian woman visiting her Ukrainian friend was physically assaulted by the friend’s neighbour, who had subjected the friend to prolonged anti-Ukrainian harassment for more than a year. During the incident, the perpetrator spat at one of the women, shouted anti-Ukrainian insults, made repeated references to the war in Ukraine, and threatened to kill and sexually assault them.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, Solidarity with Others
Report Export.Description: Two people inside a mosque were targeted in a bombing attack when two perpetrators poured a flammable liquid around the entrance and a vehicle parked outside before setting it alight. The victims escaped without injury. The incident was investigated as a hate crime.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A synagogue was vandalized with Nazi reference spray-painted on its front. This was one in a series of similar incidents targeting Jewish sites across the country.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A monument commemorating Bulgarians who opposed the deportation and persecution of Jews during the World War II was defaced with red paint. This was one in a series of similar incidents targeting Jewish sites across the country.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Holocaust memorial commemorating the rescue of Bulgarian Jews during World War II was spray-painted with green graffiti. This was one in a series of similar incidents targeting Jewish sites across the country.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: The facade of a former Jewish school was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti equating a Star of David to a swastika. This was one in a series of similar incidents targeting Jewish sites across the country.

A 22-year-old man and two male friends were beaten by four young men who shouted anti-LGBTI insults at the victims outside an LGBTI night club early in the morning. Two of the victims were hospitalized; one suffered a broken nose, a severely swollen eye, and multiple bruises. Police arrested two suspects.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 42-year-old Syrian man was punched in the back of the head and repeatedly kicked by members of a far-right extremist group, causing him to lose consciousness. The victim sustained a concussion and dental injuries. This was one in a series of three racially motivated assaults committed by the same perpetrators within 30 minutes.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 34-year-old man was physically assaulted, strangled and beaten by a group of teenagers after intervening to stop them from making racist remarks toward two women on a night bus. The victim sustained several facial fractures.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was kicked by a man while leaving a train station after engaging in public preaching.
A Kingdom Hall attendant was pushed against a wall by a man who had previously threatened to kill a congregation elder over the phone.
A female Jehovah’s Witness was kicked by a woman who approached their public witnessing cart. The perpetrator also attempted to assault a male Jehovah’s Witness.

An 80-year-old female Jehovah’s Witness was pushed by a man while preaching door-to-door, causing her to fall and hit her head against a car. The perpetrator then released his dogs at the victims as they attempted to leave.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Ukrainian woman walking with her child was physically assaulted by a Polish woman after the perpetrator heard the victim’s accent during an argument. The incident was accompanied by xenophobic insults.

Two female Jehovah’s Witnesses engaged in public witnessing were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who directed insults at them and pressed his finger against one victim’s head while simulating a gunshot.
A male Jehovah’s Witness was punched in the face and wrestled to the ground by a man while engaged in public preaching. The perpetrator had previously targeted Jehovah’s Witnesses.
