A Catholic church was desecrated when human excrement was smeared on the altar.
The car of a Catholic priest was destroyed in an arson attack overnight while parked on church grounds. The incident followed earlier acts of vandalism targeting the church.
A Catholic church was vandalized with anti-Christian graffiti targeting the Serbian Orthodox community on the eve of the Orthodox New Year.
The facade of a Catholic cathedral was vandalized with red paint after paint-filled balloons were thrown at the building during a public gathering.
A Catholic church was vandalized with graffiti and paint overnight. The incident occurred shortly after a religious celebration at the church.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Women protesters at a demonstration were threatened with rape and violence and subjected to misogynist insults by police officers who also threatened their family members.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female mayor was physically assaulted and subjected to gender-based threats, including rape and other violence, while carrying out an official inspection of illegal construction.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Three visibly Jewish teenage boys were physically assaulted and threatened with a knife by a group of six to seven men at an underground station. One victim was hospitalized. The incident was investigated as a racially aggravated assault and robbery.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Two Somali refugees were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who shouted racist insults, followed them and forced them to leave a public beach.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A Jehovah’s Witness couple were physically assaulted by security officers during a raid on their home. The female victim was knocked to the ground, while her husband was struck in the back and had his neck forcibly twisted before being taken to security service headquarters, where he was handcuffed, stripped, beaten and repeatedly subjected to electric shocks.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A male Jehovah’s Witness was subjected to ill-treatment by security officers, including denial of food, water and necessary medication for approximately 20 hours before being interrogated following a raid and search of his home. The victim suffered severe physical distress during questioning and was forced to sign a self-incriminating statement. This was the second incident targeting Jehovah’s Witnesses by security officers in the city on that day.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A non-affiliated Orthodox priest was beaten, shocked with a stun gun and forcibly shaved by state security personnel after being detained during a raid on his church. The same priest and religious community had previously been subjected to raids, prosecution and other forms of intimidation by the authorities.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Disability hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A man with an intellectual disability was grabbed by the neck and repeatedly punched in the face and body by a group who shouted homophobic insults at the victim as he left an LGBTI venue with a friend early in the morning. The victim sustained multiple contusions on his face and body, as well as a possible nasal fracture. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime.
A children’s bookstore was vandalized overnight with anti-Semitic graffiti in reference to the conflict in the Middle East.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was punched and kicked in the face and legs and dragged by her hair across the ground by a group in public due to her gender identity, resulting in injuries. The victim had previously been attacked by the same perpetrators, who also recorded the attack on their mobile phones with the aim of exposing and humiliating the victim. The incident was investigated as a potential transphobic hate crime.

Four men were repeatedly punched and kicked, including in the head, after being subjected to homophobic insults by eight young people early in the morning due to their sexual orientation. One victim lost his teeth.

Two men were punched after being subjected to homophobic insults by a group of men who saw them kissing in public late at night. One victim lost consciousness, and both sustained injuries and were hospitalized. The police later arrested two suspects and referred the case to court on suspicion of a hate crime.
The steps of a Catholic church were painted black before the Assumption. This was one in a series of vandalism incidents targeting churches across the country.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Three Serbian nationals were physically assaulted by a group of men following a basketball match near a sports hall. Two victims sustained superficial head injuries and received hospital treatment.

Report Export.Source: Centre for Peace Studies (CMS), Human Rights House Zagreb
Report Export.Description: Two Serbian men were physically assaulted by a group of four masked men after the perpetrators overheard them speaking Serbian. The perpetrators subjected them to anti-Serb insults, struck and damaged their vehicle and attempted to pull them from it. The perpetrators were charged with violent behaviour and property damage in connection with a hate crime.
The sacristan of a Catholic cathedral and several parishioners were physically assaulted by a man during Mass.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights, Solidarity with Others
Report Export.Description: A male kebab shop owner of Moroccan origin and his employee were subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of 30 to 50 masked individuals who sprayed pepper spray into the restaurant, shouted racist insults and demanded that the business close. The perpetrators later returned with baseball bats and sticks and destroyed the premises after the victims fled through a back door. The incident occurred amid broader anti-migrant unrest in the town following an attack against a 60-year-old local man.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Several employees and the owner of a hospitality business were physically assaulted, threatened with death and subjected to racist and homophobic insults. The perpetrators also destroyed property, including furniture, glassware and work materials, forcing temporary closure of the restaurant. The victims sustained injuries and required medical leave.

A female family doctor was subjected to threatening behaviour when repeatedly subjected to xenophobic insults while being filmed by a patient's relatives at her workplace. The victim suffered an anxiety attack and required medical leave.

A 30-year-old man was slapped, knocked down, and had his head repeatedly banged against the floor by three men after they subjected the victim to homophobic insults on the city's LGBTI Pride Day. The victim sustained serious injuries to his head and other body parts.
A man was grabbed, hit on the head, and threatened with having a chair thrown at him by a group of employees at a fast-food restaurant who were shouting homophobic insults.
Two football players, one of Asian origin, were subjected to harassing behaviour when repeatedly targeted with racist and anti-Asian insults by a group of spectators prior to a match.
A Black male footballer was subjected to racist harassing behaviour by a spectator who threw a banana peel at him due to his skin colour.
A Moroccan male football player was subjected to harassing behaviour when repeatedly targeted with racist insults by a group of spectators during a match.
A memorial dedicated to a Jewish family who were victims of the Holocaust was desecrated when a pig’s head was left at the site.

A 63-year-old woman was punched in the face and choked by a man shouting anti-Semitic remarks while she cleaned a memorial plaque to Holocaust victims on the anniversary of Kristallnacht. Prior to the attack, the perpetrator blew out the commemorative candle that the victim had lit. The perpetrator also wrestled the victim's phone from her hands when she tried to film the incident.

A 22-year-old gay man was was threatened when outed to his father by a fellow university student, who sent an email disclosing his sexual orientation without his consent. The victim was financially dependent on and living with his father and siblings.
A public installation in support of the LGBTI community was vandalized with anti-LGBTI graffiti.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Several people carrying a rainbow flag at a public event were subjected to threatening behaviour by three male teenage boys who repeatedly followed them while shouting homophobic and transphobic insults. The perpetrators continued to harass the group for more than 30 minutes across multiple encounters, causing the victims to seek shelter and remove the rainbow flag from their belongings.
A lesbian couple aged 19 and 23 were punched, spat on and had their hair pulled after being subjected to homophobic insults by three men at a tram stop. The victims sustained injuries.
A gay man was threatened online by a man who sent him a GIF threatening to kill and bury him.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender gay man was subjected to death threats by a man on the street due to his sexual orientation and gender identity. The perpetrator also made comments about the victim's weight.
The walls of a restaurant were vandalized with homophobic graffiti.
An LGBTI rainbow flag was torn down from a balcony, and the balcony was pelted with raw eggs by unknown perpetrators.

Two lesbian women were punched in the face, knocking one woman unconscious, by a man after he saw them kissing in public transport. The perpetrator then kicked the unconscious victim in the stomach. The victims sustained injuries and were hospitalized.
A 22-year-old man was kicked and beaten while being subjected to homophobic insults by a group who also stole his bag.
A bus stop with a rainbow column was vandalized with homophobic graffiti containing a religious reference.
A 29-year-old man was spat on, threatened and subjected to homophobic insults by a man at a bus stop.
A 26-year-old lesbian woman, along with other queer students, was threatened with physical assault by a classmate during a sex education class at a vocational school.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 28-year-old bisexual woman was physically assaulted, struck and kicked by a man in a women's restroom at a public festival, and forced to flee after he continued to threateningly pursue her.

A gay man and his partner were threatened by a group of men near a train station due to their sexual orientation. The perpetrators directed a homophobic insult at the victims after seeing one victim's LGBTI Pride-themed hoodie, and then discussed among themselves whether to physically assault the couple

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay couple and a transgender person were physically assaulted by a group of men on the street, sustaining serious injuries including a broken nose.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 22-year-old non-binary person was physically assaulted, shoved and beaten with sticks by two men in a park after they made a mocking comment about the victim's gender. The perpetrators made explicit transphobic statements during the assault.
A non-binary woman perceived as queer was physically assaulted by a group of men, who mocked them before throwing them to the ground and repeatedly striking them with their own walking stick.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A lesbian couple was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who subjected them to anti-Lesbian and anti-Semitic insults and spat in the face of one of the victims after observing them kiss on a train.
A Black man was physically assaulted by a man who struck him on the head and fled on a bicycle after a witness intervened.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender Black non-binary passenger was threatened by two men on a bus who discussed violent intentions toward them, including a throat-cutting gesture and a detailed description of intended torture, after observing them board the bus.
A person was physically assaulted at a Pride event by a teenage boy who grabbed them from behind and pulled them to the ground.

A bisexual woman and her female friend were physically assaulted at a music festival by a man who punched them in the face after spitting on them and made a death-related statement about their sexual orientation. One victim sustained damage to five teeth.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender non-binary person was sexually harassed and intimidated in a public pool's men's shower by a man who deliberately exposed himself and blocked their exit for an extended period due to the victim's perceived gender identity.
A 21-year-old female healthcare worker was sexually harassed by a patient who masturbated in front of her in the shower after previously verbally harassing her.
A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who threw beer in his face at a festival after seeing him holding hands with his partner.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender person and their partner were spat at by a man while walking on a street due to their sexual orientation.

A gay man and his friend were subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of men on boats who shouted homophobic and sexually degrading insults at them for 5 to 10 minutes while the victims were swimming. One of the perpetrators also made a sexually degrading gesture with a stick.

A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man at a tram station who repeatedly directed homophobic insults at him, stood in close physical proximity and made a conditional statement about stabbing him.

A 24-year-old Peruvian refugee gay man was physically assaulted and beaten by five men who had harassed him due to his sexual orientation on a bus, then followed and punched him in the body and face after he disembarked, causing him to bleed. The victim reported experiencing significant psychological distress following the assault.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A lesbian woman was threatened with physical assault by a man at a zoo after he insulted her and her partner based on their sexual orientation and gender non-conforming expression. Staff escorted the victims and their daughter to their car after the perpetrator threatened to assault them in the parking lot.
A gay man was physically assaulted and beaten by two men at a festival while he was with his boyfriend due to his sexual orientation. The victim sustained injuries, including bleeding.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: The walls of a youth club were spray-painted with racist, homophobic and misogynistic graffiti.
Approximately 300 rainbow flags in support of LGBTI inclusion were stolen from residents' front gardens on a single day in one municipality.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was subjected to threatening behaviour and sexual harassment by a man who repeatedly approached her on an e-scooter after being rejected, made sexually explicit remarks and demanded a sexual act.
A gay man was physically assaulted and punched in the back after kissing his boyfriend on the cheek at a public parade.
An LGBTI Pride flag was stolen from a booth and dumped in a toilet.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 48-year-old transgender woman was slapped in the face and had her hair pulled by an unknown man on a tram who demanded to know her gender.
A gay man and his partner were subjected to threatening behaviour when a passing car threw water at them while they were walking hand in hand.
The balcony of a queer youth centre was vandalized overnight with homophobic, swastika and other offensive graffiti.
A gay man was physically assaulted and threatened with death in an airport restroom due to an LGBTI solidarity sticker visible on his backpack.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay man was physically assaulted by security staff at a bar, who pushed him down a staircase due to his gender non-conforming clothing and sexual orientation. The victim sustained, resulting in a dislocated shoulder and a facial scar.

A lesbian woman and her girlfriend were subjected to sustained sexual harassment while camping by a man staying nearby who repeatedly made sexually explicit comments, including implying he would enter their tent at night, and shouted at them on multiple occasions.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was physically assaulted by two men who repeatedly subjected her to a homophobic insult and threw burning cigarettes at her while walking home from an LGBTI event.
Several LGBTI Pride march participants were subjected to threatening behaviour by passers-by who repeatedly insulted and shouted at them and made mocking gestures and sounds before leaving.

A gay man was physically assaulted during an LGBTI Pride march by a man who spat on him and injured him with a lit cigarette. The incident occurred in the presence of nearby police officers, who did not intervene.

A lesbian woman and her female partner were subjected to threatening behaviour by an older man who threw seaweed at them while they were kissing in a lake. After they confronted him, he approached them in a threatening manner and threw seaweed at them again.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A non-binary person was physically assaulted by four men who had earlier provoked attendees with water pistols from their vehicle during Pride.

A group of four LGBTI Pride participants were threatened with physical assault by a group of men who insulted them and threatened to pursue them while they were walking through the city wearing Pride merchandise. The perpetrators also attempted to tear an LGBTI Pride flag from one of the group members

A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of teenage girls who shouted homophobic insults at him and followed him into his residential building, stating they now knew where he lived.
A lesbian female student was spat on by a group of men and school property was vandalized with content targeting the victim due to her sexual orientation.
The balcony of a private residence displaying a rainbow flag was struck by a rock thrown by two teenagers, who shouted an insult before leaving.
A gay man was threatened with physical assault by a group  of people who subjected him to a homophobic insult.
A gay man was threatened with death by a group of men on a tram who subjected him to homophobic insults, displayed and brandished a pocket knife, hit the window, and threw a newspaper at his head.

A non-binary lesbian person and their partner were threatened while holding hands by a man who shouted a question about their sexual orientation and made a gesture mimicking a gun pointed at his head.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two transgender women were subjected to threatening behaviour by a teenage boy passing by who splashed them with liquid from a bottle.

A member of a group at an LGBTI community centre was punched in the chest after the group was subjected to homophobic insults and threats of physical assault. The perpetrator had earlier filmed the group without consent, ignoring requests to stop, before the confrontation escalated.
A 33-year-old gay man was punched, hit with a beer bottle, knocked to the ground and repeatedly kicked by six men in  a park due to his sexual orientation. The victim sustained serious injuries.

A 37-year old man and a 33-year-old woman were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by a person who first followed the victims and asked the male victim about his sexual orientation.
A 31-year-old man was physically assaulted by two men in the street who first subjected him to homophobic insults. The victim sustained head injuries, including abrasions.
An LGTBI rainbow bench was painted over and the dedication plaque was destroyed.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender person, their brother and a non-binary friend were physically assaulted by a man who attacked them from behind while directing transphobic insults at the transgender victim. The brother and friend were pushed into a hedge, sustaining minor arm injuries, while the victim who intervened to protect them sustained a knee injury and had their glasses knocked off.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A lesbian woman and her transgender girlfriend were subjected to threatening behaviour and sexual harassment by three teenage boys who surrounded them at a train station, asked increasingly explicit sexual questions, shouted misogynistic insults referencing sex work, and made obscene gestures as the victims attempted to leave.
A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by three teenagers who shouted a homophobic insult outside his front door and threw an open water bottle into his apartment.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender bisexual man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of classmates who sprayed him in the face with a water pistol while shouting a homophobic insult at him.
A gay man was threatened by a man who repeatedly subjected him to homophobic insults, followed him and explicitly threatened to pursue him all the way home.
Two bisexual men were threatened by a man who asked them about their sexual orientation and, after receiving a response, insulted them and threatened to kill them.

A person was physically assaulted and subjected to harassment due to their sexual orientation by two men after being tricked into a meeting in a forest. One perpetrator struck the victim, while the other followed and harassed them.
A rainbow flag was torn down from a resident's window.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender lesbian woman and her female partner were threatened with a glass bottle by a member of a group of four people on a train, after the victim asked them to stop their repeated transphobic harassment. The group had earlier subjected the couple to transphobic comments and insults.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender gay man was subjected to repeated harassment at his workplace, including being subjected to transphobic insults and mockery and asked invasive personal questions about his body.

A man was threatened when he was secretly filmed in intimate situations via a hidden camera in his former residence, revealing his sexual orientation. The footage was subsequently distributed without his consent, outing him within his personal and professional circles and causing significant reputational and psychological harm.
A 25-year-old gay man was physically assaulted and repeatedly punched in the head by a man who made a homophobic comment before the assault.
A man and his female friend were kicked and attacked with pepper spray by four men uttering homophobic insults.
A man was threatened with a knife by a man who also directed homophobic insults at the victim.

A lesbian woman was physically assaulted at a club, sustaining visible arm injuries, by a woman who first subjected her to homophobic insults.  The victim experienced significant psychological distress following the incident.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: The walls of a house were vandalized with graffiti containing anti-LGBTI and anti-Semitic statements.
Two people were punched in the face and subjected to homophobic insults at night due to their sexual orientation.
A public railing was extensively covered with threatening, anti-LGBTI stickers by a man who had previously posted the message on social media and banned queer people from his barbershop.

Rainbow flags were damaged on the evening before an LGBTI Pride Parade; the flags had been placed on the grounds of the association organizing the event. The vandalism occurred on the same day as an anti-LGBTI demonstration in town.
A private residence displaying a rainbow flag and a Bear Pride flag had eggs thrown at its windows on three separate occasions over nine months.
The facade of a queer centre was vandalized with anti-LGBTI and neo-Nazi graffiti.
A wastepaper container at an LGBTI community centre was set on fire a few days before the LGBTI Pride Parade.
A gay man and his partner were subjected to threatening behaviour when they were spat on and insulted by a group of teenage boys while boarding a tram during Museum Night.
The office of an LGBTI-rights organization was attacked when the entrance window was smashed. This was one of three similar incidents targeting the same organization in a one-month period.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Five young people were subjected to threatening behaviour while in a bar by a large group who threw stones at the bar from outside and shouted homophobic and xenophobic insults to intimidate those inside. One of the perpetrators also performed a neo-Nazi salute.
A gay couple was subjected to death threats and homophobic insults by a 22-year-old man.

The office of an LGBTI-rights organization was attacked when pelted with stones, damaging the entrance door and a window. This was one of three similar incidents targeting the same organization in a one-month period.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender gay man was sexually assaulted by a man who subjected him to unwanted physical contact and explicit coercive sexual demands, following derogatory insults and assumptions about sex work based on his gender expression.

A pansexual man was threatened with death by his supervisor, following prolonged workplace discrimination and harassment involving homophobic insults and threats. The perpetrator also made comments expressing hostility toward LGBTI people through references to HIV transmission.
A lesbian woman was confined at home and threatened by her female family member due to her sexual orientation.

A woman was subjected to threats, stalking, surveillance and repeated unwanted messages by family members who did not accept her same-sex relationship, including messages suggesting she required religious intervention.

A rainbow flag displayed on the balcony of a queer shared apartment was torn down by a person who climbed onto the private property to destroy it. The flag had previously disappeared under similar circumstances several months earlier.
A gay man was physically assaulted by a man who attempted to kick him in the buttocks at a restaurant, following derogatory insults.

A transgender gay man's residence, displaying a visible rainbow flag, was repeatedly targeted over approximately one year by a group of teenage boys who threw objects, including bottles and most recently water balloons through an open window, soaking his room and belongings.

A non-binary person was subjected to threatening behaviour and repeated homophobic insults by a man on a train, who approached them aggressively and touched their shoulder without consent despite being asked to stop.
A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of teenage boys who followed him while repeatedly subjecting him to homophobic insults.

A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who shouted homophobic insults at him while standing in close proximity and gesturing aggressively, after the victim intervened to help a woman being harassed by the same perpetrator.

A bisexual man was subjected to threatening behaviour due to his sexual orientation after being tricked into attending an in-person meeting through an online dating app under false pretences, where he encountered a group of more than five men waiting for him. As he fled on his bicycle, the group pursued him on foot, shouting aggressively.

A gay man was threatened at knifepoint and filmed by two men who took him to a secluded area under the pretext of a sexual encounter. The perpetrators threatened to use his vehicle registration number to locate his home address before releasing him.

A gay man wearing a flesh-coloured crop top and his male friend with a flower in his hair were subjected to threatening behaviour by two men who cornered them by positioning themselves in front of and behind them while repeatedly and aggressively shouting a homophobic insult.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay man and two of his friends were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic and gender-based insults by a group of men near a bar. The victim and one of his friends were pushed to the ground, and the victim was subsequently slapped, while a female friend was subjected to a misogynistic insult.

A gay man and his partner were subjected to repeated harassment by neighbours due to their sexual orientation, who defamed them and attempted to cause problems with authorities, their property management and other neighbours. The perpetrators also forced their way into the couple's home.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A gay non-binary person was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of men who repeatedly approached them in a car, stopped abruptly, shouted homophobic insults, and threw a can at them. The victim reported that this was the third similar incident at the same location, following incidents two weeks earlier and the previous winter.

A lesbian woman was threatened by a man at a train station who followed her, attempted to flirt with her and became aggressive after she disclosed her sexual orientation. He insulted her and threatened to force her to change her sexual orientation.

Two gay men in a relationship were subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of teenage boys who shouted homophobic insults, mocked them, followed them and eventually encircled them while moving closely towards them and continuing to harass them for several minutes.
A 16-year-old bisexual male student was subjected to repeated harassment by a female classmate, including homophobic insults targeting his sexual orientation and degrading sexual comments.
A gay man was physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by his neighbour.
A gay man and his boyfriend were subjected to threatening behaviour by a taxi driver who made a homophobic comment and obscene gesture, then followed them while continuing to insult them.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 12-year-old girl was physically assaulted and insulted by her mother, who made transphobic remarks about her boyfriend's gender identity as well as the victim's LGBTI affiliation. The victim also reported that her mother threatened to abandon her.

A gay man was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of 10 to 15 men who repeatedly shouted homophobic insults at him before the entire group advanced towards him in a threatening manner, causing him to flee into a nearby venue.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A transgender gay man was subjected to sustained harassment by his parents over five years in response to his gender identity, including emotional pressure, screaming, and attempts to send him to so-called “conversion” therapy. His father also repeatedly made sexually inappropriate comments and requests, including proposing a sexual act involving himself and asking to see the victim’s genitals, tied to the victim's perceived lack of sexual experience with men.
A 12-year-old bisexual boy was physically assaulted by a group of five boys who also subjected him to homophobic insults while he was walking home.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A non-binary person was physically assaulted and sexually harassed by a man on a tram, who attempted to kiss them without consent and subjected them to insults.

Two persons perceived as gay were subjected to threatening behaviour while walking arm in arm at night by a male driver who followed them in a car, repeatedly stopping to shout homophobic insults and express hostility toward their presence in the area.

Visitors to a queer venue were subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of approximately ten people who surrounded the entrance for nearly two hours, repeatedly insulting, mocking and staring at everyone entering or leaving. Some members of the group entered the venue itself to closely mock and inspect those present creating an intimidating environment.

Around 25 worshippers were subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who entered a Catholic church during Mass carrying a knife and vandalized candlesticks and church furnishings. The worshippers were evacuated from the church. This was one of two incidents targeting Catholic churches by the same perpetrator on the same day.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A researcher documenting violence against migrants was threatened with death by a neighbour, a coast guard officer, due to his work and association with migrants. The perpetrator entered the victim’s garden carrying a hand saw and warned the victim to stop discussing his and his colleagues’ responsibility for violence against migrants.

A Protestant pastor, his family and members of his congregation were repeatedly subjected to harassment over approximately 18 months after the pastor publicly expressed solidarity with Jewish victims of the conflict in the Middle East. Worshippers were filmed and footage was posted online, and the church was vandalized with anti-Semitic graffiti.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Members of a Muslim congregation were repeatedly harassed when a man released rats outside their mosque on four occasions over several weeks while shouting racist insults at people entering the building.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: Members of a Saami community were subjected to threatening and harassing behaviour when three of their reindeer were killed with their throats slit shortly after the community challenged a rally route affecting reindeer-grazing areas. Prior to the incident, community members had received racist threats and hate mail. The incident was investigated as a potential hate crime. The killing of reindeers, an animal sacred to local indigenous communities, and the placement of their carcasses, constitutes a threat to the Saami people and an act of desecration in their ancestral land.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female politician was physically assaulted and subjected to degrading and misogynist treatment by police officers during detention, including being forcibly restrained, stripped and forced to lie naked on the floor. As a result of her treatment, the victim suffered a hypertensive episode and repeated vomiting, but was denied access to medication and restroom facilities.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female activist was forced to strip naked in front of her elderly mother and subjected to threats by police officers during a raid on their home. The victim suffered a panic attack requiring emergency medical treatment.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female activist was physically assaulted and subjected to an invasive strip search while in police detention following a peaceful protest. The victim was denied contact with family and friends and was only granted access to her lawyer after the search.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A female journalist was subjected to threatening behaviour during her detention at a protest, including being spat on, threatened with violence and subjected to misogynist insults by a police officer.
A worshipper was physically assaulted by a person who had disrupted mass and shouted insults against the worshippers present during Mass.
A man was threatened with a knife and robbed by two assailants who subjected him to anti-Christian insults when they noticed the victim's cross pendant.
A man with a Catholic tattoo on his neck was stabbed in the arm by an unknown assailant.
A priest was seized by the neck and violently shaken by person who had previously been refused entry into the church.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Muslim hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: A teenage boy was hit and subjected to anti-Christian insults by three classmates at school after being forced to translate a video containing an ant-Muslim message in relation to the conflict in the Middle East.
Church windows were damaged when pelted with rocks, disrupting a service attended by about 120 people.
A number of items and documents belonging to a church were damaged by an unknown man, who entered the church and started extinguishing candles at the altar.
A Christian man was threatened with death by a man who was lingering around the church and blocking exits.
A historic Calvinistic Methodist chapel was set on fire and severely damaged by two teenagers.
A church was burglarized and targeted in an arson attack when a tapestry was stolen, a cross and other items were broken, and signage was burnt.
About 40 gravestones, as well as the exterior of a church, were vandalized with anti-Christian words and imagery.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A trans woman was spat on and subjected to transphobic insults by an unknown man.

The office of an LGBTI-rights organization was attacked when pelted with stones, damaging an entrance window. This was one of three similar incidents targeting the same organization in a one-month period.

A 20-year-old man - a young social media influencer - was hit in the face and subjected to homophobic insults by a group of three people in the street at night. The victim sustained a minor facial injury.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: An Armenian Apostolic monastery was vandalized, with religious figures removed, a cross-stone broken and a sculpture toppled from its niche. The incident occurred in territories that were not under the control of the Armenian government.
A memorial dedicated to Lesbian victims of the Nazi regime was vandalized with graffiti depicting a man's genitals.

A gay couple were followed, kicked and punched in the head by a group of five men who had subjected them to homophobic insults after noticing them outside a supermarket in the evening. The victims sustained injuries.

A gay couple were physically assaulted by a man who punched the younger victim in the face after the perpetrator noticed them out walking together. The younger victim lost two front teeth as a result.

Three participants of an LGBTI Pride event (Christopher Street Day) were targeted in a bombing attack when an explosive device exploded on the street in the evening after the event. The victims sustained injuries.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: A 45-year-old transgender woman and her male friend were physically assaulted and subjected to transphobic insults by a man while walking outside. The male victim was hit with a glass bottle, resulting in injuries.

Several gay men were physically assaulted, robbed and blackmailed by members of a hate group in a series of fake dates arranged by the group via dating apps. The perpetrators targeted the victims due to their sexual orientation.
Two young journalists were punched and kicked by 12 members of a neo-Nazi hate group due to their photographing an LGBTI-Pride event (Christopher Street Day) on the previous day.
Twenty-nine brass memorial stones commemorating Holocaust victims were spray-painted with black lacquer paint.

A man and his daughter were threatened with violence while he was driving a car by a van driver, who shouted anti-Semitic insults and then attempted to run them over with his van. The incident occurred after the perpetrator heard the victims listening to Hebrew music. A criminal investigation was launched against the van driver.
The exterior walls of two mosques were vandalized with graffiti relating to the conflict in the Middle East.
Two gay men were punched, kicked and subjected to homophobic insults by three men. Both victims sustained injuries.
A memorial plaque dedicated to an LGBTI activist was vandalized with swastika graffiti.

A drama school student was subjected to threatening behaviour by two men who repeatedly targeted them with homophobic insults. The perpetrators behaved aggressively, and also spat on and threw stones at an LGB-Pride flag hanging on the school's facade.
A rainbow-coloured staircase was spray-painted black.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: Three transgender women were sexually assaulted, harassed and subjected to insults by approximately ten men while riding on an overnight bus. Two perpetrators touched one of the women's legs and buttocks.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 43-year-old man was physically assaulted by members of the same far-right extremist group while being subjected to a racist insult. The victim subsequently suffered persistent headaches and vision problems. This was one in a series of three racially motivated assaults committed by the same perpetrators within 30 minutes.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Office for Democratic Institution and Human Rights
Report Export.Description: A 27-year-old man was punched and kicked by members of the same far-right extremist group, who also attempted to drag him onto a train platform. This was one in a series of three racially motivated assaults committed by the same perpetrators within 30 minutes.

A lesbian woman and her partner were sexually harassed by a man who approached them at a festival and attempted to touch them with his tongue while they were kissing. The victims were targeted due to their sexual orientation.
A lesbian woman was subjected to threatening behaviour by a man who blocked her exit on a bus and restricted her movements, attempting to control where she could disembark.

A lesbian woman was subjected to repeated physical assaults and threats by the same man on four separate occasions, including being injured with a knife, pushed down a slope, having her hand slammed against a wall, and being choked. She also received multiple death threats, and the perpetrator planted a GPS tracker in her bag.

Public spaces throughout the community have been repeatedly vandalized with homophobic stickers over approximately one year, with the same man also displaying a homophobic flag on his balcony, visible to passersby.

A 17-year-old participant of an LGBTI Pride event (Christopher Street Day) was physically assaulted when hit by a far-right counter-demonstrator due to the victim’s association with the LGBTI community.

Participants of an LGBTI Pride were physically assaulted and subjected to homophobic insults by members of an anti-LGBTI counter-demonstration. The perpetrators also organized a sit-in to block the event and stole LGBTI Pride materials and symbols.
Two young men were punched by a group who first subjected them to homophobic insults in the city centre at night due to their perceived sexual orientation. Both victims sustained injuries.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Christian hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Description: An LGBTI rainbow flag was stolen from inside the window of an Evangelical church by a group, one of whom performed a Nazi salute.

A young gay couple were physically assaulted by men who threatened them with a rod, punched one of the victims in the face, and subjected them to homophobic insults. A female bystander was injured when the rod hit her ankle

Muslim worshippers were threatened when a multi-page threatening letter and a USB stick were left in a mosque's mailbox. The materials included anti-Muslim caricatures and calls for violence. Police have initiated an investigation.
An LGBTI Pride Parade participant was threatened with stabbing and subjected to homophobic insults by unknown individuals armed with a knife.
A mosaic of Our Lady of Guadalupe in a church was damaged by a man using a sledgehammer.
Christian worshippers were threatened when a man carrying explosive devices was arrested outside of the city's cathedral, following evidence that he was planning a bombing attack.
A statue of the Blessed Virgin Mary was vandalized and other religious statues were damages in two different churches in the same neighbourhood.
A statue of the Virgin Mary in a cathedral was vandalized.
The stained-glass windows of a Catholic church were smashed by a man throwing bricks.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: A plaque and statue of the Holy May were vandalized with anti-Semitic and anti-Christian graffiti.
A Catholic church was targeted in an arson attack when a fire was set at the entrance.
The heads of two statues in a Catholic church were broken off and stolen.
A statue and a stained-glass window were damaged when pelted with rocks by a man.
Several nativity statues were vandalized and beheaded in the lead up to Epiphany. Similar incidents were registered in other regions of the country.
A statue of the Virgin Mary was stolen from a niche protected by glass and iron bars.
A cemetery was vandalized when unknown individuals broke crosses, destroyed graves and tore down images of saints.
A religious garment was stolen by a man, who later posted a video and threatened to set the item on fire.
A Catholic cemetery was vandalized by unknown perpetrators, who destroyed gravestones, chapels and a cross monolith.
A wooden cross of Holy Mary placed on a public road was burned down.
An archbishop was confronted and threated with a knife by a group of men after leaving mass.
Statues in a Catholic church were damaged by a Muslim man who also shouted incoherent remarks relating the Muslim faith.
Various ritual objects were stolen from a Catholic church, and other ceremonial items were desecrated. It was the third time the church had been targeted by thieves in the same month.
A Catholic school was vandalized with graffiti featuring swastikas and anti-clerical insults, as well as other offensive and threating messages referencing religion.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: Catholic worshippers were threatened when a man made 20 bomb threats against a Cathedral over the phone, along with other threats and racist insults.
A church was vandalized with anti-Catholic graffiti targeting the Catholic faith and clergy, causing material damage.

Worshippers at a church were subjected to threatening behaviour and a priest was threatened with violence by a man who interrupted Mass, threw objects on the ground, shouted, and attempted to attack the worshippers.
Nativity scene statues in two public spaces were stolen, damaged or vandalized.
A town hall nativity scene was vandalized with paint and some of the figurines were stolen.

A Kurdish peace activist, conscientious objector and political refugee was attacked in his home by 15-20 masked youth, who threw stones against him and his two housemates, shouting racist slogans. The victim had already been attacked 10 days earlier.

A foreign food delivery driver was assaulted after a minor traffic dispute and struck across the face with a navigation tablet. The incident forms part of a pattern of attacks against foreigners in the area.

A 34-year-old delivery driver was lured by a person claiming to be a delivery recipient, beaten and robbed of his waist pack, which contained a mobile phone, cash, personal documents and other items. There is a pattern of attacks against migrant workers in the area.

A 17-year-old boy was physically assaulted in a homophobic attack by two unidentified suspects, travelling in a car, who stopped and physically attacked the teenager while he was walking alone at night. The victim sustained injuries.
Outside of a church in Limassol, LGBT signs were thrown into the traditional bonfire. Photos and videos were widely circulated online.
A male asylum-seeker from Egypt was attacked by a group of young men in a parking lot. He received racist insults and was accused of attempting to steal from a car.

10-year-old child, who is a refugee from Iraq, was subjected to verbal and physical bullying by his classmates, who bruised his body and attempted to steal his phone on a school bus. He was subjected to racist insults.
Migrants and refugees staying at a Temporary Reception Centre were targeted by shooters, who severely injured six Afghan and Pakistani nationals.
Migrants and refugees reported being attacked, beaten and robbed by an organized criminal group near the border area. Victims reported threats with firearms and extortion.
Migrants and refugees were targeted by organized groups, and reported kidnappings, assaults and extortion. Victims were held and forced to pay ransom.
Migrants and refugees were physically assaulted and robbed in a public area in Bihać. Victims reported being beaten by several perpetrators and having personal belongings stolen.
Migrants and refugees reported being threatened and physically assaulted while attempting to cross the border through forest areas. Victims were robbed of money and mobile phones.

Several Turkish nationals were threatened by a few hundred men who gathered outside their residence chanting violent anti-Turkish threats. Shops belonging to Turkish citizens were also destroyed during the course of anti-migrant protests that lasted a few days.

A Romanian social media creator published videos in which he incentivized his followers to remove Ukrainian and Moldovan license plates, offering a financial reward upon receipt of proof. This resulted in several acts of vandalism in the area, causing severe administrative and financial consequences.

A female Ukrainian refugee reported being physically assaulted and verbally abused by a neighbour, who grabbed her shoulder while directing racial insults at her. The victim reported prior incidents involving the same aggressor, including kicking her grocery bags and, on a separate occasion, deliberately ramming a stroller into her husband’s wheelchair.
A female student and the school’s deputy headmistress were stabbed to death by a 18-year old student, while another was seriously injured. The motive was later confirmed as hatred of women.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Roma hate crime
Report Export.Description: Members of minority communities, in particular Roma and foreigners, were targeted by an organized group wearing masks named Valhalla, who shared videos showing physical assaults, neo-Nazi symbols and other racist slogans on social media. The conduct continued for several months.

A homeless Ukrainian man was found severely beaten outside a shopping center in Bratislava and succumbed of his injuries the following day. He was reportedly caught shoplifting and detained by private security guards and a police patrol.
A Jewish cemetery was vandalized, when offenders spray-painted swastikas on two gravestones.
A group of Ukrainian students were verbally and physically attacked for speaking Ukrainian in the local shopping mall.
A restaurant was spray-painted with a Star of David and with the word "Jew".

During several nights, migrant workers, mostly of Moroccan and North African origin, were harassed and physically attacked in public spaces near their homes by far-right groups holding anti-migrant demonstrations.

Walls and public spaces near shelters hosting unaccompanied migrant minors were vandalised with anti-immigrant graffiti. Messages included slogans such as “MENAs out” and similar phrases calling for migrants to leave the neighbourhood. These acts were repeated over a span of several months and in multiple cities across Spain.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A gay man was harassed and subjected to homophobic insults by police at the police station due to his sexual orientation. The police had stopped the victim's car on suspicion of drug possession.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender girl was subjected to threatening behaviour by a group who attempted to break into her apartment by kicking the front door and hitting it with a blunt object while she was inside. At the time of the incident, the victim was seeking assistance after previously being targeted due to her gender identity.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman and her friend were beaten by a group of men after participating in a protest to mark the anniversary of a law that discriminates against the LGBTI community. Police officers observing the rally detained the victims.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality, Women's Initiatives Supporting Group (WISG)
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was harassed and blackmailed when repeatedly targeted in transphobic content posted by a social media user via a fake account.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: An LGBTI activist who heads an LGBTI media organization received death and rape threats from a neighbour in a comment posted on his personal social media profile.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: Employees of an LGBTI-rights organization received an email containing threats and a picture of a man displaying Nazi symbols.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality, Sphere Foundation
Report Export.Description: A man was beaten by members of a hate group who tricked him into a meeting due to his sexual orientation. The incident was filmed and published on a social media platform. The victim sustained injuries and required medical attention.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality, Sphere Foundation
Report Export.Description: A young gay man was threatened with severe violence and being sent to a Muslim education institution by his father due to his sexual orientation.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender girl was threatened with eviction by her father due to her feminine appearance and gender identity. The victim had previously been subjected to forced religious therapy aimed at changing her gender identity.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality, Sphere Foundation
Report Export.Description: An 18-year-old gay man was beaten at his home for several hours by a male coworker after he learned of the victim’s sexual orientation. The perpetrator choked the victim, threatened to kill him, damaged his personal belongings and stole his keys. The victim sustained extensive bruising to his face.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A Russian male LGBTI activist was physically assaulted and raped in his home by two attackers he had met in a social media chat.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A gay man was physically assaulted at least six times by other prisoners who targeted him due to his sexual orientation. The injuries resulted in hospitalization and were accompanied by homophobic insults, social isolation and degrading treatment. The prison authorities did not intervene.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was knocked to the ground and repeatedly kicked by a group of men who had previously targeted her with transphobic insults and harassment. The victim suffered a broken collarbone and a concussion.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was repeatedly beaten, threatened with death, and subjected to transphobic insults by her father after he found documents and medication related to her transition. The victim had moved back in with her parents after previously being subjected to transphobic harassment by her neighbours.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: The organizers of a transgender rights event were repeatedly threatened with death and violence on social media, including in far-right forums, forcing the cancellation of the event.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: Participants of a private LGBTI discussion were subjected to threatening behaviour and homophobic insults by a masked group who attempted to break into the venue and then circulated the footage on social media.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Anti-Semitic hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: An LGBTI activist was threatened with death and rape by a group in a park who also poured beer on her and threatened the LGBTI community while making anti-Semitic references. The victim had previously been threatened online.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: Participants of an LGBTI cultural event were subjected to threatening behaviour by a group of men who tried to interrupt the event and behaved aggressively. The police de-escalated the situation and escorted participants through a safe exit.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A gay man was threatened when chased by five men shouting homophobic insults and threats. One of the attackers attempted to grab the victim's backpack that displayed LGBTI symbols.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A transgender woman was punched in the face, causing her to fall down some stairs, after being threatened and subjected to transphobic insults by a man at a music festival. The victim suffered a broken nose, severe bleeding, and an open facial wound, requiring hospitalization.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: An employee of a bookstore-café associated with the LGBTI community was threatened by five masked men after trying to prevent them from posting anti-LGBTI leaflets on the cafe's windows. The cafe was targeted again in similar incidents on at least two occasions.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A gay man and other customers of a gay club were beaten and subjected to homophobic insults by police during a raid on the club. The perpetrators denied the victims water and confiscated the male victim's phone without justification.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: An LGBTI community centre was vandalized with hate speech graffiti and had its windows and doors damaged by a group. The centre had previously been targeted in similar incidents.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Gender-based hate crime, Anti-LGBTI hate crime
Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: Two young men wearing feminine clothes and make-up were spanked and subjected to insults by passers-by due to their gender non-conforming appearance.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: A boy was threatened and blackmailed at school after a private video showing him kissing another boy was shared without his consent. The victim was also subjected to online harassment.

Report Export.Source: Eastern European Coalition for LGBT+ Equality
Report Export.Description: Two teenage girls were pelted with live firecrackers and chased by a large group of men in a vehicle who shouted homophobic insults and threats. One victim sustained a burn to her leg when the firecracker hit her. The police pressured the victims into not filing a complaint.

Report Export.Description: A performance venue set to host a dance ceremony affiliated with the Falun Gong spiritual movement was threatened with emails claiming that bombs planted planted inside the facility would be denotated if the event was not cancelled.

Report Export.Description: Three UK theatres hosting performances associated with the Falun Gong spiritual movement received emails threatening bombings and mass-shooting threats shortly before the event.

Report Export.Description: A theatre hosting a performance associated with the Falun Gong spiritual movement received emails claiming that bombs has been planted at the venue and demanding the cancellation of the event.

Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A theatre was evacuated after receiving a bomb threat targeting performances affiliated with the Falun Gong spiritual movement.

Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A temple was spray-painted by two individuals who wrote anti-Hindi and anti-Indian messages, causing more than $15,000 in damage.

Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: Windows, cameras and religious statues at several Buddhist and Taoist temples were damaged by a man arrested while he was attempting to target another temple.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: Two Hindu temples were spray-painted with graffiti, both inside and outside, by masked individuals, who also stole a security camera.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: Hindu temples across different locations received about 50 hostile messages, containing death threats and signaling intention to destroy religious properties.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A Sikh taxi driver was beaten and his vehicle damaged. He was called a terrorist by the attacker, who also threatened to kill him.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A monastery was damaged by two youth, who had previously tried to force the temple's doors, and broke several windows and roof ornaments.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A Hindu temple was targeted with several rounds of gunshots in three different nights while worshippers were present inside. The worship room, windows, arches, and a radio station were damaged.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A Sikh temple was targeted by a teenager who damaged sacred images and books, contaminated fruit in the langar (community kitchen) with an unknown substance, and threw potatoes against the granthi (prayer leader).

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Other hate crime based on religion or belief
Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A Hindu temple's main outdoor sign was spray-painted with hostile messages against India and its Prime Minister.

Report Export.Source: European Office of the Church of Scientology for Public Affairs and Human Right
Report Export.Description: A Sikh temple was targeted by a man who left a bag of raw meat at the entrance of the gurdwara, and was later charged with aggravated hate crime.

Report Export.Source: Observatory for Freedom of Religion and Conscience (OLRC)
Report Export.Description: Cemeteries across eight different locations in Cantabria were desecrated, damaged and looted. Several crossed, statues and decorations were stolen.
A monument commemorating ethnic Polish civilians killed during WWII was vandalized with anti-Polish graffiti glorifying the massacre, along with offensive symbols.

Report Export.Bias motivations: Racist and xenophobic hate crime, Anti-Christian hate crime
Report Export.Description: Two Ukrainian Orthodox priests were beaten and subjected to electric shocks by police officers attempting to force confessions and fabricate evidence.

Report Export.Source: OSCE Mission to Bosnia and Herzegovina
Report Export.Description: The car of a Bosniak member of the Republika Srpska National Assembly was targeted in an arson attack. The incident occurred after the politician commented on the mass killing of Bosniaks in the area during the war.
Several taxi drivers and food couriers of foreign origin were physically attacked, following an extensive public and online anti-immigration campaign.
A male Jehovah's Witness was violently hit in his shoulder by a man attending a meeting at his congregation. Previously, he had been receiving threats of physical assault.
Two female Jehovah's Witnesses were verbally assaulted by a homeless man who insulted them and tried to grab the display stand. He did not hit them but had displayed an aggressive behavior.
Jehovah Witnesses were threated to be shot when a man stopped by their display stand claiming he would purchase a weapon and kill them.
A religious gathering of the Jehovah's Witnesses was disrupted by a man who exhibited threatening and aggressive behavior towards the worshippers, before being escorted by law enforcement.
A Kingdom Hall received a threatening letter stating that someone intended to blow up a bomb in their building.

Members of a Kingdom Hall attending religious services were repeatedly harassed with the use of insults and violent language, over a period of several years. Acts of vandalism against their vehicles were also recorded.

During a religious ceremony, members of a Kingdom Hall received threats, insults and abusive language by a man who was threatening to call law enforcement. The man had been sending multiple threatening letters to the congregation.
A Jehovah's Witness branch office received several calls by two men who threatened to torture and burn alive JW worshippers, using very graphic language.
During their evangelizing activity, two Jehovah’s Witnesses were confronted by a motorist., who shouted at them and accused them of belonging to a sect, threatening them with physical violence.
During a religious service, a Jehovah’s Witness was approached by a men who repeatedly shouted that all JWs should be burned alive.
Jehovah's Witnesses stands were repeatedly targeted by the same man, who verbally assaulted members of the congregation.
A Kingdom Hall was threatened by a woman who, after receiving directions to the temple, claimed she would bring a Kalashnikov and replicated an armed attacked that had taken place in another city.
A Kingdom Hall was vandalized nine times throughout the year by unknown perpetrators, who smeared the facades with food and threw glass bottles against the walls.
A Protestant church in Erbach was vandalised and desecrated with faeces. The incident involved damage to church property and degrading acts inside the building.
Worshippers attending mass at a Catholic church were aggressively harassed on multiple occasions by a man who demanded money from them.
A Catholic congregation, including nuns, was threatened with armed robbery by a man who stormed into a chapel, shot a blank round, and behaved aggressively during Mass.

Authorities detained a Polish university student accused of preparing an explosive attack on a Christmas market. Investigators found evidence of affiliation with an organised terrorist group and of anti-Christian sentiment.

A Jehovah Witness was punched to his face and to the left side of his body by military officers who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.
A Jehovah Witness was punched to his head and his body by military officers who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

Two Jehovah's Witnesses were struck in the chest and face by military officers, were shot in their legs with a pneumatic pistols, and were forced to stand naked in freezing temperatures in front of other soldiers. The victims, conscientious objectors, received this mistreatment for seven days and suffered hypothermia.

A Jehovah Witness was punched repeatedly to his chest and head by military officers who insulted his faith, and was threatened with a hunting knife. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

A Jehovah Witness was detained in a pit exposed to rain and cold for an entire day. Stun grenades were thrown at his feet, shots were fired over his head, and he was struck in the back by military officers, who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

Two Jehovah Witness were punched to their heads and their backs by military officers who insulted his faith, who also handcuffed and stun gunned them. One victim was hit in the stomach and in his legs so violently that his knee dislocated. The victims are conscientious objectors and asked for alternative non-military service.
A Jehovah Witness was struck repeatedly to his face, eyes, and back by military officers who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.
A Jehovah Witness was punched to head by military officers, who knocked off a tooth and broke his nose. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

A Jehovah Witness was threatened over several days with blank rounds fired against his feet and his ears by military officers, who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

A Jehovah Witness was punched multiple times in the temple by military officers, subjected to gunshots fired close to his head, threatened with a pistol, and left unconscious after suffering severe stress. The victim is a conscientious objector, asked for alternative non-military service, and was insulted because of his faith.
A Jehovah Witness was hit in his face, nose and kidney by military officers, suffering extensive bleeding. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.
A Jehovah Witness was struck in his head, neck, back and legs by military officers who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

A Jehovah Witness was hit repeatedly in his liver, shoulders, hips and eyes by military officers, who insulted his faith. The victim is a conscientious objector and asked for alternative non-military service.

Four Jehovah's Witnesses detained in military units with their hands and legs tied to the floor, were repeatedly hit to their throats, stomach and genitals, and were threatened with a loaded gun. The victims are a conscientious objectors and asked for alternative non-military service.
